**" Ted Cruz is again fighting for political survival in Texas,"** New York Times'**J. David Goodman** -- "On a late summer afternoon, **Colin Allred** , the Democratic challenger to U.S. Senator **Ted Cruz** of Texas, mingled his way through a barbershop in a historically Black neighborhood of Houston.

As he did so, a barber confessed that he had never heard of Mr. Allred, a Dallas congressman and former N.F.L. linebacker, until he was told the candidate would be coming by the shop. Neither had his client.

"Everybody knows Ted," said the barber, **Christopher Williams**. "He's not giving nothing up. It's going to be a fight, and I love a good fight."

In recent weeks, the race for U.S. Senate in Texas has grown increasingly competitive, with negative ads appearing with every channel flip and public polls showing a contest within single digits. Mr. Cruz, who is running for a third term, has been leading, but he attracts less support than former President **Donald J. Trump** does.

So what may have seemed like a sure thing for Republicans in the Republican-dominated state has some party officials in Texas concerned.

"The current reality is that Texas is too close for comfort," **Matt Mackowiak** , head of the Travis County Republican Party, said in [a letter to state party leaders](https://substack.com/redirect/6cc57a0f-74b7-4597-b8fc-8dcc86d15005?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The race is on track to be one of the most expensive in state history. But among Democrats, it has still not generated anything like the fervor or attention of 2018, when another little-known congressman, **Beto O 'Rourke**, barnstormed his way to nearly defeating Mr. Cruz.

Mr. O'Rourke's near victory is still frequently mentioned by Texas Democrats, the what-could-have-been moment that, in other elections since, they have been chasing and failing to replicate. A Democrat has not won statewide in Texas in 30 years.

But the near defeat has fueled Mr. Cruz's determination not to let Republicans get overconfident this time. He has been trying to pull off a difficult political trick for a politician whose name ID is nearly universal: to remake his firebrand persona into something more approachable.

"They're going to tell you I am a horrible creature who devours kittens at sunrise, which is ridiculous," Mr. Cruz told campaign volunteers earlier this year, joking about his image in the media months before Republicans began accusing migrants in Ohio of eating pets. "Everyone knows you eat kittens at _night_."

The senator's campaign has worried that a close race down the stretch could invite new rounds of investment from Democrats, and that some middle-of-the-road Texas voters, unsatisfied with either Mr. Trump or his Democratic rival, Vice President **Kamala Harris** , may nevertheless vote in the Senate race.

That has led to a big fight over voters in the middle. Both candidates have tried to claim the mantle of bipartisanship. Both have rolled out endorsements by members of the opposite party.

**Liz Cheney** , the former Republican representative from Wyoming, is backing Mr. Allred.**Kim Ogg** , the Democratic district attorney for Harris County, which includes Houston, has been [vocal in her support for Mr. Cruz](https://substack.com/redirect/72799053-698c-4c9b-9956-247daf5d17b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Mr. Allred has demonstrated an ability to raise money to bombard the airwaves with ads and a willingness to go on the attack against Mr. Cruz.

Perhaps never has a race for Senate included so many mentions of Cancun, Mexico, where Mr. Cruz went vacationing during a 2021 winter storm in Texas that left more than 200 people dead. Mr. Allred finds ways to bring it up whenever possible, [including in an ad about Social Security and Medicare](https://substack.com/redirect/0d1f8040-e230-4455-8e88-5cbf0b75aa3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Mr. Allred, 41, played linebacker for the Tennessee Titans before becoming a lawyer. In 2018, he [defeated a Republican incumbent in a close race](https://substack.com/redirect/4e689c0a-0aa9-4103-9270-6f42d97c5ded?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to win his congressional seat in Dallas.

"Change can happen quickly in Texas," Mr. Allred, who is Black, said in an interview in which he talked about the diversity of the state. "What we have to do in Texas is embrace who we actually are, which is that diversity and that complexity that comes with it. Instead of being afraid of it."

A first debate in the race is scheduled for Oct. 15." " [NYT](https://substack.com/redirect/b8c3f7f8-a8f8-4bba-8b8c-ebdc9cac0efe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

**" Colin Allred, Ted Cruz spar over credit for microchip bill,"** Dallas Morning News'**Joseph Morton** -- "U.S. Sen. **Ted Cruz** , R-Texas, and his Democratic challenger, U.S. Rep. **Colin Allred** of Dallas, agree that Texas can expect new jobs and economic development from a bill easing permitting requirements on new [semiconductor manufacturing facilities](https://substack.com/redirect/3d05d8fb-bd11-46ed-a2b0-266324ccdc09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

The two sparred sharply this week, however, over which of them deserves credit for getting the legislation to President **Joe Biden 's** desk.

Allred's camp noted that he [co-sponsored the original House bill](https://substack.com/redirect/a9a7ac2d-4755-452b-a37b-78086e67243d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Cruz said he rewrote it in the Senate and convinced House GOP leaders to push his version over the finish line.

The dispute comes as the two candidates are locked in a competitive race, with each pitching himself as the best option to deliver on job creation.

"A win for Texas! The House passed our bill, the Building Chips in America Act, to streamline permitting and advance CHIPS Act projects," [Allred said on X](https://substack.com/redirect/6fec868b-7b05-4a2f-9482-651879b1e71a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). "Thanks to a team from both sides of the aisle, we got this done."

Repeating his criticism that Cruz is more interested in self-promotion than finding solutions, Allred added: "Ted Cruz is trying to claim credit. Classic Ted acting like a 'me guy.' "

A prime example, Allred says, was Cruz's vote against the[ 2022 CHIPS and Science Act](https://substack.com/redirect/cb876379-6a12-4be2-82f1-d9d70f39bc36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that was intended to boost [domestic production of microchips](https://substack.com/redirect/4f11dcd4-2b06-4003-9940-78432c33d94a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and is helping bring billions of dollars to new Texas facilities.

Cruz says he enthusiastically supported the 2022 bill's tax and regulatory incentives for new manufacturing facilities but strongly objected to its direct corporate subsidies.

"I am not a fan of giving taxpayer money directly to private corporations, and I think history has shown that it can lead to bad results," Cruz said. "Once the bill passed, I have actively urged as many of those dollars as possible to go to Texas."

Cruz said he was particularly interested in speeding those new manufacturing facilities through a federal environmental review process that can delay projects for years.

He recounted seeing an Allred news release announcing the original proposal to ease those requirements.

Cruz said some of the original language would have disadvantaged Texas, so he blocked it and asked his staff to write new language.

He worked with U.S. Sen. **Mark Kelly** , D-Ariz., to get that version unanimously approved by the Senate.

The reworked bill encountered resistance in the House from some Democrats concerned about undermining environmental regulations and from some Republicans who wanted a more comprehensive overhaul of environmental rules.

The House voted 257-125 Monday to approve the Cruz-Kelly version.

In an interview, Cruz talked in great detail about the various legislative twists and turns the permitting bill went through on the way to final passage as he lobbied for support in the House and urged House Speaker **Mike Johnson** , R-La., to bring the bill to the floor.

It is "utterly bizarre" that Allred would claim the legislation as his own, he said.

"The fact that Colin Allred is trying to claim credit for legislation that I drafted and that I have been fighting a year to pass is emblematic of his campaign," Cruz said.

He said Allred is trying to pitch himself as a bipartisan-minded moderate despite voting consistently with his party for years, particularly in opposition to Republican proposals to secure the border and stem illegal immigration." ($5/mo or $50/yr or $199 lifetime) TOP NEWS " Texas' growth at risk due to water shortages, urgent action needed," KXAN'sRyan Chandler -- "In Wimberley, boulders and deer bones bake in the heat where there was once a thriving creek. The lakes and rivers that once attracted Texans and enabled them to grow communities there are drying up, posing an active but underappreciated emergency that sets a limit on the "Texas Miracle," state leaders say. "Texas is out of water," Texas Agriculture Commissioner Sid Miller told Nexstar on Tuesday. "We can't grow, we can't expand, we can't have economic opportunity and jobs without water. We've reached our limit, there is no more. We've got to do some things different." Wimberley and much of Central Texas has been in a drought for most of the last two years. It has led some local officials to implement Stage 4 water restrictions, where residents are penalized for automatic water sprinklers and watering is confined to certain times. But out in West Texas, conditions are far worse. Miller said Texas loses about one farm every week, but it's not for lack of land. Farmers don't have enough water to keep their crops alive. Texas's population is expected to gain over 22 million people by 2070, according to the 2022 . Over the same period, the water supply is projected to decrease by 18%. found Texas loses 572,000 acre-feet of water per year -- enough to fill almost 240 AT&T Stadiums and supply Austin, Fort Worth, El Paso, Laredo, and Lubbock combined for an entire year. As Texas regularly faces drought periods, some lawmakers are urging the state to proactively protect the most valuable resource. "It's the silent issue, with the least urgency, with the biggest impact," State Sen. Charles Perry , R-Lubbock, previously told Nexstar. "We've been, for far too long, treating water like a commodity that has no meaning. And it's truly not. It's not a commodity. It's a necessity." On Tuesday, state lawmakers tasked with shepherding natural resources reviewed the implementation of the Texas Water Fund, which dedicated a billion dollars to water conservation projects across the state. But that sum is, for lack of a better term, a drop in the bucket. Perry, one of the legislature's longtime champions of water conservation, expects it will take billions more. "Water is the only problem that we face as a state that can literally be fixed with more money," Sen. Perry said. "It's just a commitment to a vision to provide water and a commitment of resources to get there. So that's been my frustration -- it's not one of those problems that we can't solve. The lack of urgency to deal with it is frustrating." On Tuesday, Commissioner Miller pointed to multiple tangible ways to save water -- the first is hard infrastructure upgrades. Leaky pipes alone waste more than 130 billion gallons of water every year, the Texas Water Development Board found. Fracking is also a focus -- using clean water to frack wastes and pollutes, and Miller said more companies are transitioning to brackish water. "We've got a lot to do," he said. "We've just got to get busy and help ourselves."" BUSINESS NEWS " San Antonio's USAA is laying off more employees," San Antonio Express-News'Madison Iszler -- "USAA -- one of San Antonio's largest employers -- has issued another round of pink slips. The confirmed Tuesday it had laid off more employees but did not disclose how many or which departments were affected. Online chatter suggested workers at and in compliance and consumer lending were among those laid off. "We regularly evaluate our operations and adjust to serve our members more efficiently," said spokesperson Roger Wildermuth. "USAA continues to hire across the company in line with changing business needs, including more than 8,300 jobs filled so far this year, and remains focused on providing our members with exceptional products and service." The cuts mark the company's second round of layoffs this year after it . It's at least the seventh round since March 2022, decisions USAA has attributed to "changing business needs," a tepid national housing market and slowing global economy. USAA has more than 37,000 employees nationwide, including about 19,000 in the San Antonio area. The cuts come on the heels of President and CEO Wayne Peacock 's that he plans to retire in the first half of 2025 after 36 years at the company. USAA has said it is vetting internal and external candidates to replace Peacock, who's been CEO since 2020. USAA of $1.2 billion in 2023, up from a loss of $1.3 billion in 2022 but down from a profit of $3.3 billion in 2021, according to the company's most recent annual financial report. Revenue reached a record $42.5 billion. The company provides insurance, banking and retirement solutions to more than 13 million members of the military, veterans and their families." ($) STATE GOVERNMENT " Appeals court says Texas State Fair can ban guns," Texas Tribune's Juan Salinas II -- "A newly created state appeals court denied Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton request to temporarily block the State Fair of Texas' policy banning all firearms from its fairgrounds as the event is set to start Friday. The ruling comes after a Dallas County District Court struck down a similar request from Paxton on the new policy. The District Court Judge agreed with State Fair officials that they could enforce a gun ban as a private nonprofit. Paxton says the fair's gun ban violates state law, which bars most government bodies from prohibiting weapons. State Fair officials say it has the right as a private nonprofit, and the city of Dallas says it has no role in the fair's gun policy. Paxton said on social media Tuesday evening that he will next ask the Texas Supreme Court to overturn the ban. The State Fair begins Friday." LOCAL GOVERNMENT " Dallas council members request an audit of failed lead abatement program," Dallas Morning News' Maria Ramos Pacheco -- "Two Dallas council members requested an audit into the $2.3 million failed city's lead removal program after The Dallas Morning News its outcome, which left multiple residents exposed to lead. District 13 Councilmember Gay Donnell Willis and District 1 Councilmember Chad West sent a memorandum on Sept. 16 to City Auditor Mark Swann asking him to add the program to his work plan and examine it more closely. "The audit should focus on inefficiencies in executing lead removal, and the lack of contractor availability in Dallas versus other cities where the program has been successful. It should also assess communication with residents and other stakeholders throughout the process," read the memo. Willis and West did not respond to a request for comment. The News reached out to Cynthia Rogers-Ellickson , interim director of the housing and neighborhood revitalization department, and Thor Erickson , the department's assistant director, via email but did not respond to a request for comment. The city's communication department said via email the managers in the housing department were aware of the audit and would assist the auditor in his review and provide any information requested. The Office of the City Auditor's Recommended Fiscal Year 2025 Audit Work Plan includes an audit of the lead abatement program. The work plan will be subject to final approval by the full City Council on Oct. 23. After the Work Plan is approved, the audit will be scheduled to start when audit resources are available, said Swann via email." ($) " While Bexar County barrels toward fiscal 'cliff,' San Antonio sees smoother landing," San Antonio Report's Iris Dimmick -- "The City of San Antonio put the finishing touches on its fiscal year 2025 budget on Thursday -- and with that, pledged the last scraps of its federal coronavirus pandemic recovery fund. The city allocated its remaining $5.8 million in American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) funding on one-time expenses, including expanding senior center hours, for downtown residents and seed funding for a . Meanwhile, Bexar County adopted a $2.8 billion budget that sets the county on course toward a so-called "" unless serious cuts are made or revenue is generated. The county used its last remaining ARPA funds to plug an $18.8 million hole in its general fund budget -- rather than using it for new one-time expenses, as commissioners had previously discussed. Between the newly established , program and other initiatives that require reoccurring expenses, the county has bitten off more than its budget can afford in future years without ARPA support. "How many of those ARPA-funded programs continue in the future" will come down to policy decisions made by the Bexar County Commissioners Court, County Manager David Smith said. "As soon as next budget, we're going to have to start examining some of those potential impacts." The city was careful not to over-extend itself, City Manager Erik Walsh said. It ramped up existing programs that it could wind down once funding ran out. The budget deficit that the city had to deal with this year, for the first time since 2010, was due to from both property and sales taxes -- not as a result of its dwindling ARPA funds. "We've planned appropriately for ARPA over the last couple of years and we'll continue to plan for the next year and a half," Walsh said. "Some cities added firefighters or police officers," he added. "I don't know what the heck they're going to do when that money dries out."" " Fort Worth ISD school board accepts voluntary resignation of Superintendent Angelica Ramsey," Fort Worth Report's Jacob Sanchez and Matthew Sgroi -- "The Angelica Ramsey-led era of Fort Worth ISD is over after the school board accepted her voluntary resignation. Trustees' 8-1 vote on Sept. 24 came almost to the day two years ago that trustees formally hired Ramsey, who of improving academic achievement and the district's financial standing. She now leaves the district amid criticism of unchanged student outcomes, a $17.7 million deficit budget and by district mandates. The sole dissenting vote was trustee Camille Rodriguez. The board members came out of a more than three-hour executive session and announced the resignation without comment. Ramsey's resignation as superintendent is effective Oct. 1, according to a joint statement from the school board and the departing leader. However, she will remain a Fort Worth ISD employee until Aug. 30, 2025. The school board plans to appoint an interim superintendent. The interim leader will remain in the position as trustees search for a new superintendent. During a news conference, school board President Roxanne Martinez thanked Ramsey for her service and said trustees will move forward with a focus on improving student achievement. Martinez explained her vote to accept Ramsey's resignation. "Hearing the community's concerns was a large part of why I supported the decision. I also think we mutually made a decision to move on in the best interest of children," Martinez said. "That's what my focus is going to be as president -- moving forward and improving student achievement just like our community and our parents wish to see." In a , Ramsey listed what she saw as her achievements as Fort Worth ISD's superintendent for the past two years, such as improvements seen in the . "I would like to extend my deepest gratitude to the Fort Worth ISD board for allowing me the honor of serving this district over the past two years. It has been a privilege, and I have approached this responsibility with the utmost seriousness and dedication," Ramsey said." The pressure put on Ramsey and her leadership had intensified in recent weeks after more than 40 community leaders called for a district turnaround plan. On Aug. 27, in a letter and a , Mayor Mattie Parker voiced dissatisfaction with the lackluster and stagnant state of the district. Those critical of Ramsey's tenure also noted empty promises when it came to improving and Hispanic students. Trustee Wallace Bridges voiced his concerns over the district's lack of progress in improving reading rates for Black students during school board meetings. For two years, the district has not had a plan for these students, he said." 2024 " Ted Cruz is again fighting for political survival in Texas," New York Times'J. David Goodman -- "On a late summer afternoon, Colin Allred , the Democratic challenger to U.S. Senator Ted Cruz of Texas, mingled his way through a barbershop in a historically Black neighborhood of Houston. As he did so, a barber confessed that he had never heard of Mr. Allred, a Dallas congressman and former N.F.L. linebacker, until he was told the candidate would be coming by the shop. Neither had his client. "Everybody knows Ted," said the barber, Christopher Williams. "He's not giving nothing up. It's going to be a fight, and I love a good fight." In recent weeks, the race for U.S. Senate in Texas has grown increasingly competitive, with negative ads appearing with every channel flip and public polls showing a contest within single digits. Mr. Cruz, who is running for a third term, has been leading, but he attracts less support than former President Donald J. Trump does. So what may have seemed like a sure thing for Republicans in the Republican-dominated state has some party officials in Texas concerned. "The current reality is that Texas is too close for comfort," Matt Mackowiak , head of the Travis County Republican Party, said in . The race is on track to be one of the most expensive in state history. But among Democrats, it has still not generated anything like the fervor or attention of 2018, when another little-known congressman, Beto O 'Rourke, barnstormed his way to nearly defeating Mr. Cruz. Mr. O'Rourke's near victory is still frequently mentioned by Texas Democrats, the what-could-have-been moment that, in other elections since, they have been chasing and failing to replicate. A Democrat has not won statewide in Texas in 30 years. But the near defeat has fueled Mr. Cruz's determination not to let Republicans get overconfident this time. He has been trying to pull off a difficult political trick for a politician whose name ID is nearly universal: to remake his firebrand persona into something more approachable. "They're going to tell you I am a horrible creature who devours kittens at sunrise, which is ridiculous," Mr. Cruz told campaign volunteers earlier this year, joking about his image in the media months before Republicans began accusing migrants in Ohio of eating pets. "Everyone knows you eat kittens at night." The senator's campaign has worried that a close race down the stretch could invite new rounds of investment from Democrats, and that some middle-of-the-road Texas voters, unsatisfied with either Mr. Trump or his Democratic rival, Vice President Kamala Harris , may nevertheless vote in the Senate race. That has led to a big fight over voters in the middle. Both candidates have tried to claim the mantle of bipartisanship. Both have rolled out endorsements by members of the opposite party. Liz Cheney , the former Republican representative from Wyoming, is backing Mr. Allred.Kim Ogg , the Democratic district attorney for Harris County, which includes Houston, has been . Mr. Allred has demonstrated an ability to raise money to bombard the airwaves with ads and a willingness to go on the attack against Mr. Cruz. Perhaps never has a race for Senate included so many mentions of Cancun, Mexico, where Mr. Cruz went vacationing during a 2021 winter storm in Texas that left more than 200 people dead. Mr. Allred finds ways to bring it up whenever possible, . Mr. Allred, 41, played linebacker for the Tennessee Titans before becoming a lawyer. In 2018, he to win his congressional seat in Dallas. "Change can happen quickly in Texas," Mr. Allred, who is Black, said in an interview in which he talked about the diversity of the state. "What we have to do in Texas is embrace who we actually are, which is that diversity and that complexity that comes with it. Instead of being afraid of it." A first debate in the race is scheduled for Oct. 15." " " Colin Allred, Ted Cruz spar over credit for microchip bill," Dallas Morning News'Joseph Morton -- "U.S. Sen. Ted Cruz , R-Texas, and his Democratic challenger, U.S. Rep. Colin Allred of Dallas, agree that Texas can expect new jobs and economic development from a bill easing permitting requirements on new . The two sparred sharply this week, however, over which of them deserves credit for getting the legislation to President Joe Biden 's desk. Allred's camp noted that he . Cruz said he rewrote it in the Senate and convinced House GOP leaders to push his version over the finish line. The dispute comes as the two candidates are locked in a competitive race, with each pitching himself as the best option to deliver on job creation. "A win for Texas! The House passed our bill, the Building Chips in America Act, to streamline permitting and advance CHIPS Act projects," . "Thanks to a team from both sides of the aisle, we got this done." Repeating his criticism that Cruz is more interested in self-promotion than finding solutions, Allred added: "Ted Cruz is trying to claim credit. Classic Ted acting like a 'me guy.' " A prime example, Allred says, was Cruz's vote against the that was intended to boost and is helping bring billions of dollars to new Texas facilities. Cruz says he enthusiastically supported the 2022 bill's tax and regulatory incentives for new manufacturing facilities but strongly objected to its direct corporate subsidies. "I am not a fan of giving taxpayer money directly to private corporations, and I think history has shown that it can lead to bad results," Cruz said. "Once the bill passed, I have actively urged as many of those dollars as possible to go to Texas." Cruz said he was particularly interested in speeding those new manufacturing facilities through a federal environmental review process that can delay projects for years. He recounted seeing an Allred news release announcing the original proposal to ease those requirements. Cruz said some of the original language would have disadvantaged Texas, so he blocked it and asked his staff to write new language. He worked with U.S. Sen. Mark Kelly , D-Ariz., to get that version unanimously approved by the Senate. The reworked bill encountered resistance in the House from some Democrats concerned about undermining environmental regulations and from some Republicans who wanted a more comprehensive overhaul of environmental rules. The House voted 257-125 Monday to approve the Cruz-Kelly version. In an interview, Cruz talked in great detail about the various legislative twists and turns the permitting bill went through on the way to final passage as he lobbied for support in the House and urged House Speaker Mike Johnson , R-La., to bring the bill to the floor. It is "utterly bizarre" that Allred would claim the legislation as his own, he said. "The fact that Colin Allred is trying to claim credit for legislation that I drafted and that I have been fighting a year to pass is emblematic of his campaign," Cruz said. He said Allred is trying to pitch himself as a bipartisan-minded moderate despite voting consistently with his party for years, particularly in opposition to Republican proposals to secure the border and stem illegal immigration." from me.

Here’s the context: Republicans have launched nasty attack ads against me
to mislead voters and stir up support for my right-wing opponent.

The scary thing is, their strategy may be working.

FOUR recent polls show me statistically tied with Eric Hovde, and

record straight.

Wisconsin.

[**Before I ask you to pitch in just $5,**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6850f62f91df4f488b3a6853d9ce6567&_e=RT47exWDv46ZscXL2WOYeM-j56jK4dagjLzNqKPh7bRrcXKuCp5H5IbzAL3c_8Mu6Q2vwPbGEtLY_9f5LaPMP71pOx4kjC-GN762oeqaXy7NYYrYJJi5Ywuw2eQS38vGP5NnDUcWUB1UPBQ4l1JcnPH-tZL3c7-FEOKPGsntVX7nxwD5ZGL5a-5EXW85_dModLSMW0cO1H38FYz--GQVB2grNOKPiYAUHzbRSv7LnPYUmdoNOPLaFKfwCWfm0xeFO8XmYmgON1P9ToDnCqOzgUfd4KNkzP8bF6LolmQQtVrPE2IXXHhVe7kjz5Xz4hKCaweWWn0GUOZra9YyYEcmXJ-TaF05pPUQX25BsQD53V4fmZxESpzeexuf6jzaGuhDQUjQE3ogc4KUctNPkzZTZt4ZEE0D9DwdJGUVl4T5Ws9_EIENFosXya-1-Wu1dUny) I need to tell you why taking back Wisconsin’s battleground Senate seat is so important.

1. Democrats are clinging to a SINGLE SEAT majority. **Flipping this seat will put an immediate end to their majority.**
2. This race is the closest battleground Senate race in the ENTIRE country. **Multiple polls show me on the verge of overtaking Tammy Baldwin for the lead.**
3. _Real Clear Politics_ just upgraded our race from **LEAN DEMOCRAT** to **TOSS-UP** ❗

Disclaimer from their most recent newsletter.****The Pro-RCV group appears to be the “Dark Money” they were so worried about, Arabella Advisors and 1630 Fund are about as “Dark Money” as “Dark Money” gets.**_**Their new Incorporation is their top donor.**__**Then "Article Four from Virginia"**__**Then "1630 Fund in Washington D.C."**_

This is who is funding the [#RankedChoiceVoting](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66f4dac48ccfb12c94536383&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fhashtag%2FRankedChoiceVoting%3Fsrc%3Dhashtag_click&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_66f4da0c0eeda24f9687414c&l=en-US&s=8ajcd_yBHfr_T52TbEj2ZmLd6f8%3D) group in Alaska 1630 Fund Swiss billionaire whose personal goal is to “(re)interpret the American Constitution in the light of progressive politics” has donated hundreds of millions of dollars to a left-wing group that is dumping millions into state ballot initiatives, a new report from Americans for Public Trust (APT) revealed. Hansjörg Wyss, through his Berger Action Fund, has donated $243 million to the Sixteen Thirty Fund, which “uses its war chest ... to support massive get-out-the-vote drives, issue advocacy campaigns bolstering President Biden’s agenda, liberal pet projects from abortion to immigration, and attack ads against Republican lawmakers,”

Swiss billionaire Hansjörg Wyss has been channeling substantial funds into American state ballot initiatives through the 1630 Fund aka Sixteen Thirty Fund, a progressive advocacy group.As reported by Americans for Public Trust, Wyss’s donations, which total around $243 million to the group, have been instrumental in influencing policies across various states, with a significant focus on Michigan. Since 2017, nearly $34 million has been funneled into Michigan to, among other goals, "rewrite the state’s election laws." This massive infusion of cash aims at bolstering liberal causes from immigration to abortion and enhancing Democratic voter turnout. Such activities have sparked controversy and legislative responses aimed at curbing foreign influence in American electoral processes.https://thefederalist.com/2024/04/18/dark-money-group-backed-by-foreign-billionaire-has-dumped-100-million-into-state-ballot-initiatives/1630 Fund is currently funding multiple ballot initiatives in Alaska, including Alaskans For Better Elections AKBE who brought Ranked Choice Voting to Alaska. Also including the recent push for a higher minimum wage. At some point, one must question when the regulators and government officials, elected to safeguard citizens, become tools manipulated by these malicious actors to act against the citizens they are meant to protect.(e.g. we have been attacked 4 times so far 3 times using state offices, we have been spied on, harassed, and our reputations damaged nationwide all because we were trying to address an election system we didn't feel was a good fit for Alaska)I hope you take this threat to your State Seriously, they are incredibly well funded and they are hell bent on making changes to the State of Alaska. This is one of those cases of too big to fail, where you will attack Alaskans and regular people, but applying these rules to a Swiss Billionaire is outside your job and expectations. As a citizen it saddens me to learn that millionaires and billionaires have more influence on a state and the way the state operates than the people who live here.Phil IzonPer State Statutes:**Sec. 15.13.068. name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: 📰 Our get-out-the-vote work gains the spotlight / Nuestro trabajo para movilizar a la gente para votar está en el centro de atención 📰
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Making headlines for fueling voter power in Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Guadalupe%20Ruiz%20TOP%20Dallas%20member.jpg]
Engaging voters on everyday issues they care about and connecting those issues to the ballot box; it's TOP's electoral 'bread and butter.'
This voter engagement work of ours was highlighted by the Dallas Morning News this past Sunday at the top of the fold on the front page!
READ ALL ABOUT IT. [https://www.dallasnews.com/news/elections/2024/09/19/2024-election-north-texas-voter-turnout/]
Featured is longtime Dallas TOP member Guadalupe Ruiz , and her journey from being a non-voter to a habitual voter who's fighting for healthcare justice, all thanks to TOP knocking on her door and inspiring her to cast her ballot in 2014. We know from election and policy wins that building progressive infrastructure in Texas takes time and ample resources. By uplifting issues that matter to everyday Texas families -- from housing affordability, to healthcare access, to legal system reform, and more -- we're challenging the status quo in an effort to transform our state for the better. It's how we get closer to a true #TXForAll, a future every Texan has the freedom to thrive -- no matter their age, race, gender, or income.
Remember: the last day to register to vote in Texas is October 7. Early voting starts October 21. Spread the word, and let's keep this momentum going!
TOP Co-ED Brianna Brown shares organizing wisdom at Florida Rising convening
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/01%20-%20BB%20at%20Florida%20Rising.jpg]
TOP Co-Executive Director Brianna Brown took to the stage at Florida's Rising's annual Statewide People's Assembly on September 14th to deliver spirited remarks focused on how our movements' shared values are vital tools in our collective fight against MAGA fascism.
During her speech, Brianna highlighted how TOP's three key organizational values -- regeneration, vision, and solidarity -- drive our daily work, while emphasizing the striking and frustrating political similarities between Texas and Florida (Abbott and DeSantis can't be voted out soon enough!).
Florida Rising is a close movement ally of ours in the fight for racial and economic justice, working to build progressive power year-round in the Sunshine State. Learn more about their organizing here. [https://floridarising.org/]
Celebrating recent promotions on Team Teal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Celebrating%20new%20job%20roles.jpg]
Organizing is at the heart of everything we do at TOP. It’s the lifeblood of our issue-based and electoral campaigns that champion people-centered policies and build progressive power in both our physical and digital streets.
That’s why we’re ecstatic to share the news of three recent promotions at TOP, with Shareen Woody now serving as HR Director, Tempestt McHenry as Statewide Political Field Coordinator, and Tarasha Hollis as Statewide Political Data Coordinator.
TOP is excited to see where the leadership of Shareen, Tempestt, and Tarasha takes our electoral work and organizing, as we continue to confront the powers that be to advance racial and economic justice in our communities. We as Texans know our worth. All of us deserve to live in a state that values us for who we are, respects our full humanity, and provides us with opportunities to thrive.
Join us in cheering on these three tenacious and talented Black women as they help move TOP’s #TXForAll vision forward!
TOP Tip: Check out our Digital Page and let's start organizing
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20Digital%20Page%20graphic_2.jpg]
TOP is proud to launch our new DIGITAL PAGE — your one-stop shop to TAKE ACTION with us and plug in to our organizing work. Browse the new page at act.organizetexas.org [https://act.organizetexas.org/] and together let's connect online to drive meaningful change in our communities!
Español
Estamos en los titulares por impulsar el poder de los votantes en Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Guadalupe%20Ruiz%20TOP%20Dallas%20member.jpg]
Involucrar a los votantes en los temas de todos los dias que les preocupan y conectar esos temas con las urnas; es el "pan de cada día" electoral de TOP.
¡Este trabajo nuestro de participación de votantes apareció en el Dallas Morning News el domingo pasado en la parte superior de la página principal!
LÉELO TODO AQUÍ. [https://www.dallasnews.com/news/elections/2024/09/19/2024-election-north-texas-voter-turnout/]
Guadalupe Ruiz , miembro de TOP de Dallas desde hace mucho tiempo, y su recorrido desde ser una no votante a una votante habitual que lucha por la justicia en la atención médica, todo gracias a que TOP llamó a su puerta y la inspiró a emitir su voto en 2014. Sabemos por las elecciones y las victorias políticas que construir una infraestructura progresista en Texas requiere tiempo y abundantes recursos. Al promover temas que importan a las familias comunes de Texas, desde la asequibilidad de la vivienda hasta el acceso a la atención médica, la reforma del sistema legal y más, estamos desafiando el status quo en un esfuerzo por transformar nuestro estado para mejor. Es cómo nos acercamos a un verdadero #TXForAll, un futuro en el que cada tejano tiene la libertad de prosperar, sin importar su edad, raza, género o ingresos.
Recuerde: el último día para registrarse para votar en Texas es el 7 de octubre. La votación anticipada comienza el 21 de octubre. ¡Difunda la información y mantengamos la motivación!
La codirectora ejecutiva de TOP, Brianna Brown, comparte su sabiduría organizativa en la reunión de Florida Rising
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/01%20-%20BB%20at%20Florida%20Rising.jpg]
La codirectora ejecutiva de TOP, Brianna Brown, subió al escenario en la Asamblea Estatal anual de Florida Rising el 14 de septiembre para entregar comentarios fuertes centrados en cómo los valores compartidos de nuestros movimientos son herramientas vitales en nuestra lucha colectiva contra el fascismo MAGA.
Durante su discurso, Brianna subrayó cómo los tres valores más importantes de la organización de TOP (regeneración, visión y solidaridad) impulsan nuestro trabajo diario, al tiempo que enfatizó las sorprendentes y frustrantes similitudes políticas entre Texas y Florida (¡Abbott y DeSantis no pueden ser expulsados lo suficientemente pronto!).
Florida Rising es un movimiento aliado cercano nuestro en la lucha por la justicia racial y económica, que trabaja para construir poder progresista durante todo el año en el Estado del Sol. Obtenga más información sobre su organización aquí. [https://floridarising.org/]
Celebrando las promociones recientes en Team Teal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Celebrating%20new%20job%20roles.jpg]
La organización es central en todo lo que hacemos en TOP. Es el elemento vital de nuestras campañas electorales y basadas en temas que defienden políticas centradas en las personas y construyen un poder progresista.
Por eso estamos encantados de compartir la noticia de tres promociones recientes en TOP: Shareen Woody ahora se desempeña como directora de recursos humanos, Tempestt McHenry como coordinadora de campo político estatal y Tarasha Hollis como coordinadora de datos políticos estatales.
TOP está entusiasmado de ver hacia dónde lleva el liderazgo de Shareen, Tempestt y Tarasha nuestro trabajo electoral y nuestra organización, mientras continuamos enfrentando a los poderes fácticos para promover la justicia racial y económica en nuestras comunidades.
Nosotros, como tejanos, sabemos nuestro valor. Todos merecemos vivir en un estado que nos valore por lo que somos, respete nuestra humanidad completa y nos brinde oportunidades para prosperar.
¡Únase a nosotros para animar a estas tres mujeres negras tenaces y talentosas mientras ayudan a impulsar la visión #TXForAll de TOP!
Consejos de TOP: Visita nuestra Página Digital y comencemos a organizarnos
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20Digital%20Page%20graphic_2.jpg]
TOP está orgulloso de lanzar su nueva PÁGINA DIGITA L, su ventanilla única para TOMAR ACCIÓN con nosotros y unirse a nuestro trabajo de organización. ¡Explore la nueva página en act.organizetexas.org [https://act.organizetexas.org/] y conectémonos juntos en línea para elevar un cambio significativo en nuestras comunidades!

Our new Senate Majority is going to come down to five critical Democrat-held seats in Montana, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Nevada, and Wisconsin

Friend, this year is already one for the record books.

Just like in 2020 and 2022, Democrats are raising record-breaking sums in the closest Senate races.

It's plain and simple: we're in danger of a Republican Senate majority slipping out of our grasp if our candidates don't get the support they need to stay competitive in these neck-and-neck races.

2\. **[Pennsylvania:](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zniuicuaga47bert0iehp1rm28dret9uk302k2g0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm2o76cth2bs)** West Point Graduate Army Captain Dave McCormick is running against Democrat Senator Bob Casey.

3\. **[Ohio:](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z306jebrbjrn6jlvpsa5dm66v42ib7emq03c4880_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm2o76cth2bs)** We need to support businessman Bernie Moreno against Sherrod Brown, who has raised the most money of any incumbent Democrat Senator.

Democrat Jacky Rosen has brought in 3 dollars for every 1 Sam Brown has raised and has a 3 to 1 cash-on-hand advantage.

He has invested $13 million of his funds into his campaign to narrow the financial gap with Democrat Tammy Baldwin. He has skin in the game, but he can't fund his campaign alone - we need to step up for this principled conservative.

The opportunity to flip these five seats and take back the Majority is with Republicans. But we must keep the pedal to the metal through these final weeks and days of this cycle.

We have no excuse to fail in 2024. It will be squarely on Republicans if we squander this opportunity to flip five neck-and-neck seats. **[Help our friends win by chipping in whatever you can today!](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zrlov36rgf8ds36brffqqqqmppfgk32lkus8kgeg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm2o76cth2bs)**

body:
Our new Senate Majority is going to come down to five critical Democrat-held seats in Montana, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Nevada, and Wisconsin

Friend, this year is already one for the record books.

Just like in 2020 and 2022, Democrats are raising record-breaking sums in the closest Senate races.

It's plain and simple: we're in danger of a Republican Senate majority slipping out of our grasp if our candidates don't get the support they need to stay competitive in these neck-and-neck races.

Democrats have a massive financial advantage in nearly every race, but here's the good news. ⬇️⬇️

**CQ ROLL CALL: ["Senate's most vulnerable list still dominated by Democrats"](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zeqohpm35eofdc8ti76v11q2d4jl6t9gephioto0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob2clh2bs)**

_Here is where you can help in the most competitive races:_

1\. **[Montana:](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zcel6af50u5a9aouqadpa2c0k3kaihtjqn49n5ng_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob2clh2bs)** We need to help Former Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy defeat liberal Jon Tester, who votes with Kamala Harris and Joe Biden 95% of the time.

2\. **[Pennsylvania:](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zl9sssod0vggkd198mvls4nc7qn92hsj91ns63d8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob2clh2bs)** West Point Graduate Army Captain Dave McCormick is running against Democrat Senator Bob Casey.

3\. **[Ohio:](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zie60nmfsngrpkcaqqursfvqu30rf6gracga6t8g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob2clh2bs)** We need to support businessman Bernie Moreno against Sherrod Brown, who has raised the most money of any incumbent Democrat Senator.

4\. **[Nevada:](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z07op476122ol6ljvjtodn35j685hivfvegjfa48_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob2clh2bs)** We must help retired Army Captain and IED-blast survivor Sam Brown overcome his financial disadvantage. Democrat Jacky Rosen has brought in 3 dollars for every 1 Sam Brown has raised and has a 3 to 1 cash-on-hand advantage.

5\. **[Wisconsin:](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zab15oaoc6qgsn6lfvlkejs4j9sb5ntjnjlpmfeo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob2clh2bs)** We can't let down Eric Hovde. subject: We can’t retreat into our homes
body:
I'm writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.

| |

---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative,
---
| | I'm writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.Actually, in my case, it's a slippery _slide_. My name is Riley Gaines and I'm the University of Kentucky swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6'4" _male_ swimmer dressed in a women's bathing suit.And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had to go back to the women's locker room and undress out of my wet bathing suit while he did the same next to me.
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z5t8q5vanrv32g5ok0d53cs5nk2p4bg8pm2cacg8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob6c5h2bs)
---
| | I know the images I'm bringing up are horrible. But please don't stop reading -- because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to do today. We can't retreat into our homes and hope our government's evil culture just passes us by. **[That's why I'm asking you to stand with me today -- before it's too late.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ze595320n85skfri67m26jq7bjpeba54fmfls388_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob6c5h2bs)** My fellow conservative, you know this slippery slide.It's the same one you got pushed down when the Left told you abortion was going to be "safe, legal, and rare."_Now abortion is a "right" and "women’s healthcare." And if you don’t support it up until the moment of birth, you must "hate women."_ It's the same slippery slide you got pushed down when the Left told you limiting gay couples to civil unions was "mean." You were told, "They just want to use the word "marriage" like everyone else. It's just a word."_Now if you don't fully embrace a homosexual lifestyle by displaying rainbows and celebrating gay pride, you're a "hate-filled bigot."_ Enough with their lies. We have Truth on our side. And we need to start acting like it.**God created man. And God created woman. It isn't any more complicated than that.** Letting men believe they are women... letting girls believe they are boys... is a bold-faced rejection of God’s truth. And if we give this deranged movement one more inch, a year from now when you're forced by law to call boys "she"... when it becomes normal for kids to be taken away from parents who oppose this evil... I don't want you looking back with regret wishing you had done something when you still had a chance.**Your chance is right now -- and right by my side.** **[Please stand with me against the radical transgender movement by making an urgent tax-deductible donation today -- before it's too late.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zamgk10a7qvukrebjsfs40uoefmsfo4o833k275g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob6c5h2bs) **The radical transgender movement has parents backed into a corner. But when I'm speaking around the country, I meet so many seniors who say, "I wish someone had told me about this sooner." The good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help me stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their slippery slide.And today I'm writing you on behalf of a group that is doing more work to block the transgender movement than anyone I know. **It's the legal non-profit the Center for American Liberty.** **[And your tax-deductible gift today is going straight to help them.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z937avsl13p930f50gplt4h24okb5sd76u47n150_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob6c5h2bs)** With the help of patriots like you, the _Center for American Liberty_ fights the transgender movement _in the courts_ because that’s the only way to stop them. And the _Center for American Liberty_ is attacking this evil from all sides with their comprehensive three-pronged approach.
---
**#1. They're fighting radical schools**.
---
---
**#2. They're fighting radical doctors.**
---
---
**#3. They're fighting for _your_ right to speak out against this evil.**
---
**[**When you make your tax-deductible gift today**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zj96o2cr0ssn7q0oshtvk8aca04qdqdelv36em98_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob6c5h2bs)** , you're helping the _Center for American Liberty_ protect every American's right to speak out against this evil! I know you'd probably love to fund an entire court case on your own after all I've told you.**[But all I'm asking you to do is make a tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, $75, $100 or even $250 or more today -- before it's too late.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ztvo778ejtdva0oa666v69437unqecuti2v6jnfg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob6c5h2bs)** Please donate whatever amount is right for you whether it's smaller or larger. _The Center for American Liberty_ needs and appreciates every dollar that comes in.And because I believe so strongly in the work they're doing -- and because they are one of the few groups who've stood shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight... I**t will be my honor to send you my new book _Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That's Lost Its Mind_ as my free gift** **[**when you donate $100 or more to the Center for American Liberty.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvbc9cq5g3heb3ig8b4aq8nc2g7kroqur80slal0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob6c5h2bs)** Before I go, please let me share one last thought with you.Every morning as a competitive swimmer, I would get up and think of this verse: _For I consider that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy to be compared to the glory that is about to be revealed to us. Romans 8:18_ I applied it to my swimming: work hard now and wins come later. But now I see that God has a much bigger plan for my life just as He does for yours.Thank you for reading my letter all the way to the end. I'm praying for you, and I hope you'll pray for me too.
---
Sincerely,
---
| | Riley Gaines
---
|
---

The attempts to deny those basic truths, are attempts to deny the truth of God. Your help is so critical to the _Center for American Liberty's_ work, **[when you donate $100 or more, as my personal "Thank You," I'll send you my new book,_Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That's Lost Its Mind_ for free.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zas85svfh2a4lo9b7q3e5vfascd19rua37ji1r5g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpgm1ob6c5h2bs)** Please hurry. We have Truth on our side. And we need to start acting like it.God created man. And God created woman. It isn't any more complicated than that. Letting men believe they are women... letting girls believe they are boys... is a bold-faced rejection of God’s truth. And if we give this deranged movement one more inch, a year from now when you're forced by law to call boys "she"... when it becomes normal for kids to be taken away from parents who oppose this evil... I don't want you looking back with regret wishing you had done something when you still had a chance.Your chance is right now -- and right by my side. The radical transgender movement has parents backed into a corner. But when I'm speaking around the country, I meet so many seniors who say, "I wish someone had told me about this sooner." The good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help me stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their slippery slide.And today I'm writing you on behalf of a group that is doing more work to block the transgender movement than anyone I know. It's the legal non-profit the Center for American Liberty. With the help of patriots like you, the Center for American Liberty fights the transgender movement in the courts because that’s the only way to stop them. And the Center for American Liberty is attacking this evil from all sides with their comprehensive three-pronged approach. #1. They're fighting radical schools. #2. They're fighting radical doctors. #3. They're fighting for your right to speak out against this evil. , you're helping the Center for American Liberty protect every American's right to speak out against this evil! I know you'd probably love to fund an entire court case on your own after all I've told you. Please donate whatever amount is right for you whether it's smaller or larger. The Center for American Liberty needs and appreciates every dollar that comes in.And because I believe so strongly in the work they're doing -- and because they are one of the few groups who've stood shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight... It will be my honor to send you my new book Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That's Lost Its Mind as my free gift Before I go, please let me share one last thought with you.Every morning as a competitive swimmer, I would get up and think of this verse: For I consider that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy to be compared to the glory that is about to be revealed to us. Romans 8:18 I applied it to my swimming: work hard now and wins come later. But now I see that God has a much bigger plan for my life just as He does for yours.Thank you for reading my letter all the way to the end. I'm praying for you, and I hope you'll pray for me too. Sincerely, | | Riley Gaines | | | P.S. God made man and God made woman. The attempts to deny those basic truths, are attempts to deny the truth of God. Your help is so critical to the Center for American Liberty's work, Please hurry. It's getting hard to hold back this evil without you. I don't want you to look back a year from now and say, "I wish I had done something when I had the chance." | | | | | The Center For American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization fighting against growing anti-free speech and anti-civil liberties trends. © The Center for American Liberty | PO Box 200942, Pittsburgh, PA 15251 | ICYMI News PO Box 1188 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

| | Friend, I got a few free minutes this morning, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life. I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.The truth is, when I jumped in this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-RM&utm;_tc=RM-20240926rty state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates.But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. I’ll be honest, this is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S.One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits, we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.So, please:Can you make a $6 contribution to my campaign today? The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. It’s going to add up fast when a ton of people chip in together.

| | Dear Fellow Conservative,
---
| | I'm writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.Actually, in my case, it's a slippery _slide_. My name is Riley Gaines and I'm the University of Kentucky swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6'4" _male_ swimmer dressed in a women's bathing suit.And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had to go back to the women's locker room and undress out of my wet bathing suit while he did the same next to me.
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zcjp51nue5b2n447nheov15hni07l4agsq3sued0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7cpim4o32cph2bs)
---

# Titus Desperately Lies to Stay In Power
---
Dear Peter,
You have a clear choice in Nevada's First Congressional District race. You can choose an honorable and honest military veteran who offers practical solutions to our problems or a career politician who lies to the people she represents. Dina Titus is spending millions of dollars on expensive TV ads. You might think she would use these ads to discuss the issues affecting Nevada families, such as inflation, open borders, failing schools, or Social Security. Or maybe she will talk about her dismal record as a 35-year career politician. Instead, Titus has spent the millions she's received from lobbyists and special interests to lie to her constituents. That's right! Instead of addressing ongoing issues plaguing Nevada, Titus lies about the one issue already settled in Nevada. She is lying about my position on the issue of abortion. My position has not changed. Here it is: Abortion is a settled law in Nevada. A referendum of the people passed it, which means neither the Governor nor the State legislature can overturn it. Only the people of Nevada can change it.
Like 71% of Americans, the people of Nevada think there should be limits on abortion. In Nevada, those limits are 24 weeks, followed by the life and health of the mother. Dina Titus ignored the will of the people when she voted for a federal law to allow abortion up until the day of delivery and to have the government pay for these unlimited abortions.
I support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe vs Wade, not just because I'm pro-life, but because it is the correct legal decision. Even Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg stated that the Roe decision was on shaky legal ground. There is nothing in the Constitution about abortion.
When the Constitution is silent on a topic, the power is vested in the States and in "We, the people." The people of Nevada have spoken. As your representative in Congress, I will not support any federal action that goes against the will of the people of my district. In the coming days leading up to the elections, you will hear Titus and others talk about abortion. They will bring it up because they don't want you thinking about inflation, the border crisis, crime, or our failing schools. Remember, the people of Nevada have already spoken on abortion - it is settled law. When career politicians in Nevada bring up abortion, they are just trying to divert your attention from their disastrous policies, which have devastated our country. Don't let them get away with it.

A. Medicare and Medicaid should remain available, but no other taxpayer-funded programs are necessary. Billions of Medicaid dollars are stolen yearly due to waste, fraud, and abuse. A. Very conservative, but not extreme. Our nation's founders created a system of checks and balances that require compromise. Indeed, our very nation was born from compromise. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.The truth is, when I jumped in this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-1600D&utm;tc=1600D-20240922rty state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates.But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. I’ll be honest, this is one of the toughest races in the country. My name is Riley Gaines and I'm the University of Kentucky swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6'4" male swimmer dressed in a women's bathing suit. The good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help me stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their slippery slide. ## Death Penalty Use at a 20-Year High
Five death row inmates [across multiple states](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2z2yAQAH-N1OERHOagoEjjzmlTak7oZF2ChEfgj_z7N371K3e22dk_1_FKkmW__aaNY1vKSKnJk8egjFPGjraf48JsGHqOGg3COViEfo3ToMHhjOQYNLvFTqABvHdhQW0ZeolmMHYIxulhQDAnHTR4D-gSWj9p3dmBZ2nlOP0tsreVl_y_PPk4pbL1Oa6t3WsHvzpz6cyF7ju_6kd94GiSMnfmwm9OjyZlr6r8y7SWjRRlmmgjtUmt5XGIavymqmp5tFUlOkqWndSMSKAnJiTrIVhjaUne-5Bw9ng-90ec7y_JWarDzg63jSR_p7WfRz2j-QoAAP__xL9p5g) faced execution within the span of this one week, the most within seven days in the U.S. in over 20 years.The first occurred Friday in South Carolina, and two more took place in Missouri and Texas on Tuesday. The two remaining executions are scheduled this week in Alabama and Oklahoma.In Alabama, inmate Alan Eugene Miller, sentenced to death [for the 1999 murders](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uwyAUQOGnwRsWXAg_A0Olylu6VFVHi8C1Q4UhMsRp3r5q585nOfo-z_PZp5zK-uY3dH2psw89HThbCoqCnOUQ3YIIKAZ0XIMWJyu1GK5OaYYsRERrhDEK-BJ1ZD4axoxS3g7JAQPJLCjOmBYwcsuFMUKroKW5cE4kw5h63cevmkq_4pKf9cB9DHUbsrv2fmtEvBCYCEz-Ego-2rjW30xg-ngnMEGJtKS-1xULXX2j-I3h3lMt9N5ow05v2QekPvuL3zyBqfW6P4mYUiTilXNhT1KDHnYXb4-Uc2pKE8nWzaf899H_Vzkc_AQAAP__uqtifw) of three people, is set to receive the second-ever nitrogen gas execution today. According to the [Death Penalty Information Center](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz71yhCAUQOGngW4duCA_BUUau02b0kG86s0gOC5rsm-fmTRp0p7mzPdxH--RMpX1Pe4Y2lLHmBpdOPobmBvoUfM5LIiAimOQFqzqvbaKb0GDnIRUk1cuOQdx6j0AzFEagb3BnlMAAVp4MFIIq6CTXirnlDXJajdJybTAmVo9u89KpW245Fe98OxS3XkOW2vHg6k3BgODYcbYtgNLzO1FZaldPVcGA35jejaq5cFgeB6p7lTW21_lZ5iPL8qZHsYyLdY9Uv4dtP-5V4CfAAAA___gmFfi), seven more executions are scheduled for this year.

We need to support businessman Bernie Moreno against Sherrod Brown, who has raised the most money of any incumbent Democrat Senator. 4\. We must help retired Army Captain and IED-blast survivor Sam Brown overcome his financial disadvantage. Kamala Harris plans to confiscate your guns

**" Kamala Harris 'supports _mandatory gun confiscation_ '"**

Did you see this headline, friend?

## Dallas Firm Agrees To $48 Million Settlement
Dallas-based Invitation Homes, the nation's largest owner of single-family rental homes, has [agreed to pay $48 million](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L1y6yAQxfGnkTo8sKBFKihu4863TalBsFgk6GPERnbePuNM2pRnfs2Z_9ttvPlc8nr_7xdy_Ezb6APnk8ZBAAowo2mjm2QcVEtOWbC600qpdnaoLA4EJmhPEtGmABhRT0rioGNv2-xAgpEDoJIdarzoXpuefJDRWhvQNEZSzLwdF56J6elrKl_bScclbEtb3My810b_a-DawNXvKz3qi17j4BwKNXDN65nZc95WMW8LVfH-uX6IRFRF4iAOWtmXXwq9SSrFOHVE0PVT9JKUmhJSLwc0tj1c3B-5lFzRNkbeF5_Lzxn-o83p4DsAAP__9bdmFw) to settle claims of deceptive practices. The Federal Trade Commission accused the company of [charging tenants undisclosed fees](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOhCAURb8GOww8ELSg2MZutt3SMPAYSRQm8qIzf7-Z7be7yc3JSc7Pbbn5vOXy-PY7OnqluvhA-cRl4mA46EV30d1FnGSHTlqwalBSym51As04puSHIcAoEFFP-g7WJGmFgnHosgMBWkxgpBiMMr0alR7RBxGttcFopgXGTPXoaUXCl29pe9cTjz7UvdvcSvRsTH0xmBnM13X14d4KXu3zM5g_k8Gcy5nJU66Fr3XHxiMGzCdGfmAhPBqvhSfExhMF3vz7A3WHi88rb1tuxjItHrvP25-X_slwOvgNAAD__1-lYOI) for services like internet and air-filter delivery, unfairly withholding security deposits, and evicting tenants who had already moved out. The settlement will fund customer refunds and requires Invitation Homes to improve price transparency and establish procedures for handling tenant security deposits fairly. Invitation Homes has [denied any wrongdoing](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DGPhCAUBOBfgx0GHwhaUFxjt9deaVh8KInCBt7q3r-_7PZXzzfJZH5u883FPab12x1o6RXy7DzFE-eRg-agZtUs9i6WsWvQdgaM7GXXdc1mvR7RgIc7ChcGlL3BEaS_h172g-5dEy0IUGIE3YleS93KQaoBnReLMcZrxZTAJVIuLW1I-HI17L_5xNL6fDS73YgelckvBhOD6bquNuQX6C0_K-X0RgymhFdlMMV0RnIUc-JbPrBytxbEyguGZ1q4GvgR9_0dF0yEpXIXCAsP5HlMJ1aK66feFLs8rret2jAl1sPF_TOI_vnntPAXAAD__zNga3U). As of June 30, the company owned or managed over 109,000 homes across the U.S.
## Alex Jones' Infowars To Be Auctioned Off
Talk show host Alex Jones will be forced to [sell his Austin-based media company Infowars](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L9yrCAUgPGnwQ4HEEELitvY7W1TOkc4q2eHFSP4J2-fSfrUX_PN7-MxPoAirfN_eKMr9zON4AudOPZcGa70qKvgJhF6WaGTVtmmbaSU1eJEq7sQJt8DBqul6fCJAC2obhKTmWxFTgmlRa-MFK1pTN10je4QvAjWWm800wIDlbTXZcGCN-Rn_Eon7rVP7yq6pZQts-YfUwNTw3VdtV_2tP5UpobpyLRizkwNsBfyEZkaXkeYkZfEYdv2dCKHwxdKa-aRPg8KUGidOUS8-SutmLnsbS-UtPW2bNXuwnZRjJSNZVrMb6D4-1L-oDmd-g4AAP__IkBoYw) to help pay nearly $1.5 billion owed to the families of those killed in the 2012 Sandy Hook shooting. In 2022, Jones was [ordered to pay $1.487 billion](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLtu7CAYhJ8Gd_-Km8EuKE7jbk-b0sLws5BgYxn29vaRkzrlzGg0o-_jOl9tymm7_bcrmvYKZbaupQfOI3AFXM6y82ahfmQdGqa5Fr1gjHXR9AN3kg3a635gwatR9sMiNPPUKSmC6JLhlEs6csVor4S6iEHIAa2jXmvtlCSSok-tHJcWseHL1pDf5YHHxZW1yya2tlci_hE-ET61iDHlfGaETwfe7tm2VDbCJ1fuR4PFtpaxEj7JYRyF6MFmfMFn2bBWSFsoT3tUaAUWBHt3Zxk9lBBOL2LeYbdvqHbzb4ilfEGwa8oJKzDoYUk5_851h_H785RVaSLpbbXp51fX_kD4MPw7AAD__9--dMM) after being convicted of defamation for claiming the shooting was a conspiracy to advance gun control measures, filing for bankruptcy shortly thereafter. Infowars' assets, estimated to be worth $7.2 million, will be auctioned off this fall. Jones has suggested his supporters could buy the company, which would potentially enable him to continue his affiliation with it as an employee. Jones' $9 million in personal assets is also subject to the order, but he is being allowed to [keep his social media accounts](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO4yAYhJ8Gd1jwg8EuKK6hy7VXWhz8tskSiAyJ47dfefutZoqR5tP37zbfXEwxr3_dA037LGV2vsU3zhMFRUHOsgvmPwsT79BwDVoMgnPebUZq4ZVynmEAyfWAo_R6mBaJctRK6C4aYCDZBIqzQQnVi1HIEZ1nQWvtlSSSYYit7H3bsOHH1SWd5Y1778ujS2Zr7VmJ-EPAErDHcfSv6loJ7rwGBGxtZT8J2IxHvcK1WDIBe_0SsGy6-kDAxryUw-2VuoQfei8ZK60uh5NupXzRupXSYl7p_RVWJGD1IEbGhWRME7DdbsLziCnFqjSRbH24mH4Y2y_K3ga-AwAA__-UBGuq). However, Sandy Hook families have requested the liquidation of those accounts and a portion of Jones' future earnings.

U.S. News & World Report released its annual rankings of the best national universities in the country, and [five Texas schools](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uMyEQAJ8GOp9gwXAUFJ9kXeevTXniZ22j4MOCjc95-yjuU46mGGk-zus5lFq26_9wR0-vS1tDovLE1R3AHECvmmcfRXaSo5cWrDoqKSW_-QhWmaO8aOd0DCaniBa1THMys3ERePEgQAsHRoqjUWZSs9IzhiSytTYZzbTAXKj1iW5I-ArjUr_bE_uU2p1XfyN6DKb-MVgYLPu-T19jw338agZLxEGH1GrFKw4GC72YWtbROjF16mH7ZGDeeCodE5W2MXUKI_Hu82MvtZZhLNPieg-lvpP0x4Gnh58AAAD__23XXo4) landed in the top 100. | | Friend, I got a few free minutes this morning, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life. I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.The truth is, when I jumped in this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-1600D&utm;_tc=1600D-20240922rty state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates.But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. I’ll be honest, this is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S.One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits, we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.So, please:Can you make a $6 contribution to my campaign today? The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. It’s going to add up fast when a ton of people chip in together.

It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life. I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.The truth is, when I jumped in this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-1600D&utm;tc=1600D-20240922rty state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates.But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. I’ll be honest, this is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S.One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits, we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.So, please:Can you make a $6 contribution to my campaign today? The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. body:
But please don't stop reading -- because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to do today.

| |

| | I’m writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.

| |

| |

[](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5e4a0256f074f01be7716b6ef19bcef&_e=iajr99oXG1Ziwj9us882lFL7XUSkjo4y15rEef5WH_i8TWl9uvBtz1nsNz4KAwQJ2QobslpAo4GuNEFDo-f45Zjohq4l3QZ-drikyvwsPKgH6wuZ1GXaBmoODrAmTi9ESqMXL3pJOPr6XmYpu6KXNLLTOLAi_24r5fzijU6KGKtEA4H3PkYcJCSG2kcz2TYx6Nhk-6Kf6rvQZwln0BF_qpqRH6Y7-wnCT05SnmPG0hkpeB5xVsvIypnkxPTgMBz5m8gDtJixiYIn2lvLnDqiwJ2cdvcO61YziRO4ovbl5PnsX2TCJe1E0hw8-hvvzdk1iJg7HjguI5wRnhV7IfqgIqMlD-u36e5NhJbth-6Q7KbdJO2UO5m_wBK9xYajHD91qPuNVUwe3KlFHk43MCBiDw%3D%3D)
---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative,
---
| | I'm writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.Actually, in my case, it's a slippery _slide_. My name is Riley Gaines and I'm the University of Kentucky swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6'4" _male_ swimmer dressed in a women's bathing suit.And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had to go back to the women's locker room and undress out of my wet bathing suit while he did the same next to me.
---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5e4a0256f074f01be7716b6ef19bcef&_e=iajr99oXG1Ziwj9us882lFL7XUSkjo4y15rEef5WH_i8TWl9uvBtz1nsNz4KAwQJ2QobslpAo4GuNEFDo-f45Zjohq4l3QZ-drikyvwsPKgH6wuZ1GXaBmoODrAmTi9ESqMXL3pJOPr6XmYpu6KXNLLTOLAi_24r5fzijU6KGKtEA4H3PkYcJCSG2kcz2TYx6Nhk-6Kf6rvQZwln0BF_qpqRH6Y7-wnCT05SnmPG0hkpeB5xVsvIypnkxPTgMBz55ztUP2ERiXeyW7Cf6rXjB0W7MUQWyFjP8YbkkZZiVBwELAwifiv167fLakW2RcMKKSENeDcbonFC6Ji5a11chfehei_UteIaJZbF9bFjpfy8BgIZ3-7YdvzVt25dcfxFGnPxFxwky0t1SdDBm9J5eg%3D%3D)
---
| | I know the images I'm bringing up are horrible. But please don't stop reading -- because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to do today. We can't retreat into our homes and hope our government's evil culture just passes us by. **[That's why I'm asking you to stand with me today -- before it's too late.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b5e4a0256f074f01be7716b6ef19bcef&_e=iajr99oXG1Ziwj9us882lFL7XUSkjo4y15rEef5WH_i8TWl9uvBtz1nsNz4KAwQJ2QobslpAo4GuNEFDo-f45Zjohq4l3QZ-drikyvwsPKgH6wuZ1GXaBmoODrAmTi9ESqMXL3pJOPr6XmYpu6KXNLLTOLAi_24r5fzijU6KGKtEA4H3PkYcJCSG2kcz2TYx6Nhk-6Kf6rvQZwln0BF_qpqRH6Y7-wnCT05SnmPG0hkpeB5xVsvIypnkxPTgMBz5xd5JwTzUUZyQTFbE64yJkb1Lqow9bAG7s17IAP61KlFom5nnf68r0YCHZ6gH1LPgNk1-UQgJS2-V5NOjgHjZC7kKSYPl7IZ8jxel63m2t9nUUl2k66l5FRWp1sVonAJu1sMssu3rt4scsFqfcRY2Zg%3D%3D)** My fellow conservative, you know this slippery slide.It's the same one you got pushed down when the Left told you abortion was going to be "safe, legal, and rare."_Now abortion is a "right" and "women’s healthcare." And if you don’t support it up until the moment of birth, you must "hate women."_ It's the same slippery slide you got pushed down when the Left told you limiting gay couples to civil unions was "mean." You were told, "They just want to use the word "marriage" like everyone else. It's just a word."_Now if you don't fully embrace a homosexual lifestyle by displaying rainbows and celebrating gay pride, you're a "hate-filled bigot."_ Enough with their lies. We have Truth on our side. And we need to start acting like it.**God created man. And God created woman. name: Amy Brown
subject: My husband's life plans changed in 60 seconds
disclaimer_text:
Paid for
by Sam Brown for Nevada
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWSZFh7WNX
I'm telling you this because I want you to know the type of man
he is
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWSZFh7WNX

Friend,
I'm not telling you this only in hopes that you'll rush for your
pocket book.

I'm
telling you this because I want you to know what type of man my
husband is.

This is
Amy Brown. My husband Sam Brown is the Republican nominee for
U.S. Senate in Nevada.

I first
met my husband in the burn unit when he returned from Afghanistan
after a roadside bomb exploded under his vehicle.

There was
one thing about Sam that caught my attention immediately.

It wasn't
the burns on his body, it wasn't the scars on the face.

His
vibrant faith in God glowed brightly even in his darkest days.
Everyone that encountered Sam could see it.

For me,
Sam was a light that guided me, challenged me, and reconnected me
with God and the Church.

I had
grown up in the Church but had lost my Faith - I was at my rock
bottom until I met Sam.

During
that time, I shared with him some of the struggles I had faced.

He told
me he was concerned for my Salvation - and for that matter so was
I.

That
brought us to where we are today, 15 years later. We have 3 kids
and I'm a Bible-believing momma who puts Bible lessons in our
family's homeschool curriculum.

Friend,
if i hadn't gone through my darkest days, I may have never met
Sam and never found a way back to God the way that I did.

Everything Sam had planned to do with his life changed in 60
seconds in Afghanistan, but it never changed who he was.

His faith
never wavered.

His hope
never left him.

His
dedication and desire to serve has not faded to this day.

Although
he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on
account of his injuries, he never stopped fighting for others.

I'll be
honest with you. This campaign hasn't been easy on our family.

Today I
wanted to ask you to help Sam and our whole family make this
sacrifice worthwhile.

We need
your help to send Sam to the U.S. Senate because he's the one man
who will NEVER back down from WHO HE IS no matter what.

Would you
please consider making a donation of any amount to Sam's
campaign?

Thank you
in advance for your time, your consideration, and your support.

Sincerely,

Amy Brown

Sam Brown
is a retired member of the U.S. Army. Use of military rank, job
titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement of
the United States Army or the Department of Defense.

His dedication and desire to serve has not faded to this day. Although he would never be permitted to return to the line of duty on account of his injuries, he never stopped fighting for others. I'll be honest with you. This campaign hasn't been easy on our family. Today I wanted to ask you to help Sam and our whole family make this sacrifice worthwhile. We need your help to send Sam to the U.S. Senate because he's the one man who will NEVER back down from WHO HE IS no matter what. Would you please consider making a donation of any amount to Sam's campaign? Thank you in advance for your time, your consideration, and your support. Sincerely, Amy Brown Sam Brown is a retired member of the U.S. Army.
