subject: Before Trump takes the stage in Michigan tomorrow
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1970%2E135344%2E6pM5-D)

Friend --
Trump will be in Michigan tomorrow for his 11th visit of the 2024 presidential campaign.
**I am asking for a contribution -- $3 or whatever you can afford -- before Donald Trump takes the stage tomorrow. If that's all you need to hear, please use this link to donate today:**
**[https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/-Trump-Visit](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240926-1-900&t=2&akid=1970%2E135344%2E6pM5-D)**
Here's how former President Trump's visit plays in our race:
We know that both the presidential race and the Senate majority will be decided by Michigan – and recent polls show that our race is a dead heat.
Given that the Senate race is the top of the ticket in the state, we know that whatever happens in our race will impact the presidential, too. That’s why Trump has given Mike Rogers his full-throated endorsement -- and why he’s attacked me directly, by name, calling me a “far-left liberal lunatic.” We expect to hear that and more tomorrow, unfortunately.
He knows that in order to win Michigan, the Republican nominee needs to win the Senate race – and he’s going to do whatever he can to make that happen.
That means we can likely expect to see Trump in Michigan a lot more in the stretch -- especially since absentee ballots drop today, meaning voters can start casting their ballots NOW. At the same time, national Republicans are doing everything they can to flip our state red and boost our opponent in the Senate race.
If we are going to keep this seat blue in November, we need to hold the line by keeping our own positive TV ads on the air, doubling down on our field outreach, and continuing to meet voters in every corner of the state.

| Greater Georgia Newsletter September 26, 2024
We're now 40 days from Election Day, and Greater Georgia is working harder than ever to make sure that the conservative movement shows up BIG for our state this year!
Throughout the month of September, we dedicated significant time and effort toward registering new voters across our state, with a continued focus on outreach to diverse communities and young Georgians. With about two weeks until the October 7th voter registration deadline, we're making it our goal to mobilize as many voters as possible, but we're also looking ahead to our get-out-the-vote campaign and absentee ballot chase program, which will be crucial to the outcome of this election.
It's not too late for you to get involved and make a difference this election year! Our team has hundreds of thousands of voters we want to reach before early voting starts on October 15th - and we need your help to share with them the conservative message. Volunteer deployments have already begun - so don't miss out on your chance to help preserve strong, conservative leadership in our state. Young voters' top concern is the economy - and whether or not they'll be able to find a job or pay their bills after graduation. We're encouraging them to vote accordingly this November - and to remember that the power to preserve the American Dream is in their hands.

A sold-out crowd got to hear from elected officials including Governor Brian Kemp, former Hawaii Congresswoman Tulsi Gabbard, and Republican vice presidential nominee and Ohio U.S. Senator JD Vance. clean_body: September Edition | | | | == | | | Greater Georgia Newsletter September 26, 2024 We're now 40 days from Election Day, and Greater Georgia is working harder than ever to make sure that the conservative movement shows up BIG for our state this year! Throughout the month of September, we dedicated significant time and effort toward registering new voters across our state, with a continued focus on outreach to diverse communities and young Georgians. With about two weeks until the October 7th voter registration deadline, we're making it our goal to mobilize as many voters as possible, but we're also looking ahead to our get-out-the-vote campaign and absentee ballot chase program, which will be crucial to the outcome of this election. It's not too late for you to get involved and make a difference this election year! Our team has hundreds of thousands of voters we want to reach before early voting starts on October 15th - and we need your help to share with them the conservative message. Volunteer deployments have already begun - so don't miss out on your chance to help preserve strong, conservative leadership in our state. Please consider signing up to help by clicking == or by emailing mailto:info@greatergeorgia.com | | | LATEST FROM GREATER GEORGIA | == | == | Earlier this month, Greater Georgia launched a six-figure campaign to expose the failures of Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis ahead of her November 5th election. The effort is designed to highlight how Willis has spent her tenure chasing vanity cases to grow her celebrity, line her pockets, and fuel her political ambitions - while crime has risen and prosecutions have fallen across the county. The campaign is targeting Atlanta-area voters with text messages and a digital ad entitled "Failed." Read more about the campaign == or click == to view the ad. == | Also this month, Greater Georgia announced our final push to register thousands of new voters ahead of the state's October 7, 2024 registration deadline. The six-figure effort is targeting a universe of approximately 180,000 unregistered Georgians and includes phone calls, digital ads, and text messages, as well as in-person voter registration drives and phone banking events. Read more about the campaign ==. | | | IN THE NEWS | == Greater Georgia was featured in Fox News - in an article highlighting our campaign to educate voters about the public safety failures of Fani Willis. Read the article ==, or read the excerpts below: "Fani Willis had one job when voters took a chance on her in 2020: put criminals behind bars and protect the families of Fulton County. Instead, she's spent the last four years focused only on chasing vanity cases instead of criminals in an attempt to grow her celebrity, line her pockets, and fuel her political ambitions," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "On her watch, prosecutions are down, crime is up, and more citizens have become victims - denied justice because she is too distracted and too incompetent to deliver it. Fani Willis is a profound embarrassment to the state of Georgia, a threat to public safety, and the number one local official who must be ousted this November in order to get Georgia's safety back in line," she said. | == | Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler also joined the Steak for Breakfast podcast to discuss what's at stake in the 2024 election, how the conservative movement is uniting people from all political backgrounds, and to give an overview of her efforts to reach diverse communities and new voters across our state. Click == to listen to her full interview. | | | EVENTS Vietnamese Moon Festival September 21, 2024 We strongly believe in meeting voters where they are - in communities where conservatives rarely show up. Accordingly, this past weekend, Greater Georgia volunteers and staff had an incredible time at the Vietnamese Moon Festival and Night Market in Duluth. It was the first time we'd ever attended the event, but it won't be the last. We were thrilled to meet so many from the AAPI community, and had a great time encouraging them to bring their same energy to the polls in November! | | | Voter Registration Drive at Georgia Southern September 19, 2024 Greater Georgia staff also made a swing through south Georgia last week, where we held a big voter registration drive on the campus of Georgia Southern University in Statesboro. Young voters' top concern is the economy - and whether or not they'll be able to find a job or pay their bills after graduation. We're encouraging them to vote accordingly this November - and to remember that the power to preserve the American Dream is in their hands. | | | Georgia Faith & Freedom Coalition Victory Dinner September 16, 2024 Greater Georgia was also proud to co-sponsor the Georgia Faith & Freedom Coalition Victory Dinner at the Cobb Galleria Centre last week. A sold-out crowd got to hear from elected officials including Governor Brian Kemp, former Hawaii Congresswoman Tulsi Gabbard, and Republican vice presidential nominee and Ohio U.S. Senator JD Vance. The speakers highlighted the importance of electing leaders who support faith, family, and freedom - and why every voter must get out to vote their values this November. | | Voter Registration Phone Banking September 9-26, 2024 Greater Georgia held multiple phone banking nights throughout the month of September in Cobb, Fulton, Gwinnett, and Dawson Counties, where volunteers and interns came together to call thousands of Georgians who weren't yet registered to vote. As the registration deadline approaches on October 7th, we're making a final push to reach new voters, educating them about the importance of their vote and empowering them to make their voices heard. If you would like to help us make calls - either at home or at one of our upcoming in-person phone banks - click ==! | | | Hispanic Heritage Month Celebrations September 14-15, 2024 This month, Greater Georgia also joined two big community celebrations in Lilburn and Norcross to honor Hispanic Heritage Month. Our volunteers and interns had a great time speaking with voters, getting new ones registered, and encouraging them to get involved by making a plan to vote! | | | AAPI Community Roundtable August 27, 2024 Last month, Alpharetta's very own Madras Chettinaad Indian restaurant hosted Chairwoman Loeffler and members of the Asian American and Pacific Islander (AAPI) community for a discussion about the issues at top of mind this year. We dove into how inflation has slammed small businesses, how crime is affecting their communities, and how best to offer these groups an alternative ahead of the November election. | | | 8th District Fish Fry August 24, 2024 The 8th District Fish Fry in Perry was, as usual, a great opportunity for Greater Georgia to assist voters in updating their voter registrations, sign up new volunteers, and catch up with old friends from middle Georgia and across the state. It's always one of our favorite events of the year! | | | | | Hispanic Community Roundtable August 21, 2024 Finally, Greater Georgia held its latest Hispanic community roundtable last month at the Plaza Las Americas in Lilburn. It was an amazing night discussing the issues that matter most to Hispanic Georgians. One thing was clear: voters from diverse communities no longer believe the broken promises of liberal leaders. They believe in the American Dream - and the conservative movement that lifts EVERYONE up! | | | | | GET INVOLVED Greater Georgia's work is critical to defending conservative values, and it is only possible through the hard work and support of strong, grassroots volunteers. Click the buttons below to find out how you can join the fight for conservative values! | | == | | == | | | DATES TO REMEMBER | | | | ON SOCIAL MEDIA | == == == | == == == | | | WHAT WE'RE READING | == Georgia election board approves rule to hand-count ballots night of election == Trump leads Harris within margin of error in tight Georgia race, poll finds == Racing toward Election Day, control of U.S. Senate and House up for grabs == Trump planning to attend Georgia-Alabama football game == Sharply divided Georgia voters are more upbeat on the economy, AJC poll finds | | | To learn more, visit ==, and follow along on ==, ==, and == to stay up to date with the latest information. | | == | | | Paid for by Greater Georgia Action, Inc. # Senator Jon Ossoff Endorses Patti Hewitt!
_U.S. Senator Jon Ossoff has formally endorsed Patti Hewitt in her campaign for Georgia’s 1st Congressional District_
---
| Peter,

We are thrilled to announce that [**U.S. Senator Jon Ossoff**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=fdf27a9769&e=0f456155ff) has officially endorsed Patti Hewitt in her race for Georgia’s 1st Congressional District!

As someone who knows what it takes to defeat tough Republican incumbents, Senator Ossoff’s endorsement is a powerful signal that Patti has the momentum to WIN in November! Here’s what Senator Ossoff had to say:

_“Coastal Georgia deserves a voice in U.S. Congress that is committed to improving access to healthcare and expanding economic opportunities. Patti Hewitt will be that voice.”

— Senator Jon Ossoff_

This endorsement is not only a huge vote of confidence in Patti’s leadership but also a signal to all of Coastal Georgia that **we have the momentum to WIN in November!

Why This Matters:

**Senator Ossoff knows firsthand that every vote—and every dollar—counts in tight races like ours. With **only four seats needed to flip the House** , Patti’s leadership will be key to ensuring Coastal Georgia finally gets the resources and attention it deserves.

**Our Time is NOW!

** This endorsement gives us incredible momentum, but we need your help to keep it going. The end of the quarter is fast approaching, and we have a big goal to hit **before September 30th**. Every contribution between now and the end of the month will help us fund critical outreach and voter mobilization efforts across the district.

**Will you chip in $50, $100, or whatever you can to help us reach our goal and fuel Patti’s fight to bring real change to Coastal Georgia?**

Let’s do this!

P.S. - Want to help spread the word about this exciting endorsement? Share it with your friends and neighbors or follow us on social media to stay in the loop!

| | | During a campaign stop at a grocery store in Pennsylvania, Trump handed a woman $100 in cash for her groceries and said "We'll do that for you from the White House." And he apparently may have done this multiple times. Here's the problem – it's illegal to pay someone to lure their vote, and Trump may have violated campaign finance law with his grocery store stunt. Trump knows he can't win fair and square so now he's handing out cash in the checkout line. He must be investigated immediately, and if he's guilty of violating campaign finance laws, he must be held accountable. clean_body: My September deadline is 11:59 pm Monday! | I want to thank you for taking the time to hear me out. Truly, just opening this email is a sign of support that can go a long way in a race like mine. You see, I need to send emails like this one because I don’t have the kind of mega-donors or special interests funding my campaign that my opponent does. She relies on contributions from the gun lobby, the oil industry, and pharmaceutical companies. I rely on YOU. In fact, I don’t take one cent of corporate PAC money — it’s the right way to run this race, but it does make things harder. I have to ask more of my supporters, more often. = I’m well aware that the fight to take on Marsha Blackburn and her mega-donors won’t be easy. That doesn’t mean it isn’t worth it. That’s why I’m reaching out today. This race could be won or lost on a dime, y’all. Meeting each of my financial goals is absolutely key to our success, and I’m relying on grassroots donations to get there. (Small-dollar gifts add up!) = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = I couldn’t do this without you! | Peter, Where is all our money going? And what are our elected officials even doing? We deserve to know. Unfortunately, in much of our country and New Jersey especially, corruption and a lack of transparency abound in our government. Just a few examples...
* Our legislature [hides tax hikes under seemingly harmless names](https://xtz223.keap-link019.com/v2/click/7df837dedba2f2d17a40c3e05fbe6aeb/eJyNkMtuwjAQRf9l1jF-AGmaHUIIRaEsqnZdufGouATbciYNFOXf69KKVZG6nnPP1Z0zEDrtqDJQwpE-lZpCBhEbGyw6WnpHurlc1XwmpzKD1rr9Ovo-QHn-M3wFLqm7Is-ATgET8vS4WNbVdv2yqbZ1IoOOqeN_niIXV8_qYVFtYBxvivFgafWR3B2UFHv8XmRsWkXPsU38jih0JefDMEyCby3Zxk8af-AOh44roWZc5FwV3L0zitp1lhjpI9vZPbLX3rwhMYO6ZULIfH4vZerUIaAzvw-r8fTTPH4BBcNyRA==)–like when our government disguised a tax hike to throw more money at our broken transportation system under the name “corporate transit fee.”
* Our school boards push woke curriculum and [shut parents out](https://xtz223.keap-link019.com/v2/click/8be9b7a2881ea933817f7c36fa8f6769/eJyNkEFPwkAQhf_LnLuWFtCmN0IIaQocjJ7Nul3tYjsz2Z0aK-l_d0XDSRPO873v5c0JxKJGqRoo4UM-83wOCXhrHDuLsiYUbc7XfLnI5lkCncO3raeBoTz9Gb4A59RdUSQgI9uIPNyv1nV12D7tqkMdSdY-dlznKW5nF89mv6p2ME3_im3vZPMe3QFK8YP9XtS4uEoefRf5VoRDmaZ4zGbZ8sZQn_bkrcKjCqYl6oLSDbE4fFX94LkdgxKvMSimzpkRSdyLM1ocoXrWmMZOzWyx-X1Ybcef5ukLkkB1qw==) of important decisions regarding their children
* And our governor–whose office is arguably full of corruption–just signed [a law to make it MORE difficult to obtain government records](https://xtz223.keap-link019.com/v2/click/72606e21908f0ed91511d642705d1936/eJyNkM1OwzAQhN_F5xin6Q-QW1VVVZTSA4IzcpxVanDWlr1JCFXeHRMQXEDiujvz7cxeGAFKpKJmOXultyxbsoR5UNppQNpZJKnmbbZeLZaLhBmNLwdvO8fyy6_mb8Hsur5NE0ajgyh5uN_uyuJ0eDoWpzIqnfTxxv84N5sfzv5uWxzZNP0JhlbTvo_swHLyHXw0qnVsRY_eRP2ZyIVcCIThGXyAsbWoyforZVuRpdlKpBuRrkVje9523p1HHnSDgVfaGO6hl63T2HDXVUarOFDW14EbOXCNvDJ24GQ5eYlh7qhGLuveKkkQRMwnnQOsv55bwviZcnoHAp2Ffg==).

So what are we supposed to do about it? We can get angry–and we should–but that isn’t all we should do. I write to you often about grabbing back the megaphone and speaking out. That isn’t just talk, it’s the whole founding purpose of the Common Sense Club. **We need to DEMAND to know how our elected officials are using our hard-earned money. After all, they work for US.** The Left wants us to forget that. As the 2024 Election is underway, it really seems like we’re only hearing about Leftist policies from the media. It can make those of us left with common sense feel isolated, like we’re the only ones seeing the government waste, the overspending, and the “woke” damage. That is all by design. The Left WANTS us to feel like we’re the crazy ones. They want to gaslight us into feeling like we’re in the minority. If we begin to speak our minds and call out their nonsense, something powerful will happen. Our neighbors and friends will say “That’s exactly what I was thinking. I thought I was the only one!” And when the Common Sense Majority can come together and get loud, the Left will no longer be able to silence us. That’s our mission–and my personal mission as President of Common Sense Club: to empower you to speak up! We’d love for you to join us. If you’re not a member, consider becoming one! body:
Prop. 127 is ballot box biology gone wild and Mesa County wisely stood against it
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, September 25, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Browning: Prop. 127 is ballot box biology gone wild and Mesa County wisely stood against it](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY LINDY BROWNING, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Prop 127, a ballot initiative brought through the efforts of an extreme animal rights activist group, Cats aren’t Trophies (CATs) is a slap in the face to wildlife experts at Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW). It’s also exploitation through deception for voters who love wildlife._
_Western Colorado voters know that wildlife management is critical to healthy ecosystems and healthy and diverse wildlife populations._
_Once again, Western Colorado is leading the way. On Tuesday, Sept. 24, Mesa County commissioners stood for all 900 species of wildlife in Colorado, stood for livestock growers and took a stand in supporting the experts and biologists at CPW. They passed a resolution opposing the ballot measure._
_Hitting the nail right on the head, Mesa County Commissioner Bobbie Daniel said, “This is a ban on (wildlife) management, people will be voting not to have management.”_
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Water roundtable sought common ground to secure a future with water](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado Water Roundtable Event focused on the urgent need for comprehensive water management as the 2007 Interim Guidelines near expiration in 2026, involving diverse stakeholders from agriculture to tribal groups.
* Key discussions included the necessity of long-term planning, potential legal challenges with the Colorado River Compact, and the economic impacts of water management on local communities.
* The event emphasized the importance of including tribal perspectives, adapting to climate change with flexible water management strategies, and fostering cross-sector collaboration to ensure sustainable water use for future generations.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In 3rd District, Club 20 debate unveiled sharp contrast between candidates Hurd, Frisch](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* In the Club 20 debate for Colorado's U.S. House District 3, Democrat Adam Frisch criticized partisan politics and accused Republican Jeff Hurd of being influenced by corporate interests, while Hurd emphasized the neglect of rural areas by state and federal policies.
* The debate highlighted key issues such as economic disparities, water rights, energy policies including nuclear energy, and the management of public lands, reflecting stark differences in the candidates' approaches and solutions.
* Both candidates acknowledged the necessity of bipartisan cooperation to effectively address district-specific concerns like water management and land use, stressing the importance of local stakeholder involvement in these discussions.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado Federation of Republican Women hear from Legere, Fidora at fall meeting](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The 86th annual Colorado Federation of Republican Women’s fall meeting featured a "Get Out the Vote" workshop and grassroots lobbying training by the Leadership Institute in Glenwood Springs.
* The event included the inauguration of a new club, the Garfield County Republican Women, and presentations by Lorie Legere, the National Federation's regional director, who discussed national activities.
* The meeting concluded with a speech from Republican National Committeewoman Christy "Ruckus" Fidora, updating members on her efforts and initiatives.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Douglas County to enforce camping ban on public property; each violation could be $1,000 fine](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX 31 NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Douglas County, Colorado is set to enforce a camping ban on public property starting October 25, aiming to manage public spaces and avoid the development of homeless encampments.
* The ordinance requires written permission for camping and prohibits temporary structures without authorization, with violations subject to fines up to $1,000.
* While county officials claim the ordinance and supportive services like the HEART program have effectively managed homelessness, critics argue it merely displaces the problem and unfairly penalizes the homeless without offering sustainable housing solutions.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Majority of suburban women in swing states say Harris lacks ‘viable solutions’ for economy: Poll](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [WASHINGTON EXAMINER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A significant majority of suburban women in swing states are concerned about Vice President Kamala Harris's ability to manage the economy, with 70% believing she lacks effective solutions, especially when compared to former President Donald Trump.
* The Place America First super PAC survey highlights the economy as a top priority for 72% of these women voters as the 2024 election approaches.
* Additionally, Trump appears to be gaining favor among key demographics such as English-speaking Hispanics and veterans, with 65% and 67%, respectively, favoring him over Harris on various issues.
* Despite a slight increase in poll numbers for Harris after the debate, Trump is shown to be leading in key states such as Arizona, Georgia, and North Carolina, while Harris maintains a lead in Pennsylvania.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Iran has already made attempts on Trump’s life that ‘didn’t work out,’ he says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEW YORK POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former President Donald Trump has disclosed that Iran has attempted to assassinate him multiple times, which he states have been unsuccessful.
* In response to these threats, the U.S. Secret Service has significantly increased Trump's security detail, and Trump noted that Congress has provided additional funding for this purpose.
* Trump's campaign highlighted ongoing and specific threats from Iran aimed at destabilizing the U.S. and influencing the election, with law enforcement across all agencies working to protect him.
* This revelation came alongside a Senate report detailing the steps taken to enhance security after earlier assassination attempts against Trump, including a significant incident at a rally in Butler, Pennsylvania.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Navigating Colorado’s legislative landscape at the Club 20 debates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | SEPTEMBER 24** _As Colorado elections draw near, the Club 20 debates offer a glimpse of the possible representation from which to choose in the state legislature._
**[Prop. 130 will create $1 million death benefit for emergency responders](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | SEPTEMBER 23** _When there’s an emergency — a home break-in, fire or heart attack — Coloradans depend upon emergency responders from the far stretches of the Eastern Plains to the Western Slope and places in between to be there._
__
**_[Amendment H ensures accountability in Colorado’s judiciary, retired Chief Judge Maes say](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_**
** _[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | SEPTEMBER 23** _Even though retired Colorado 10th Judicial District Chief Judge Dennis Maes has plenty to do as a board member for Pueblo School District, he writes monthly articles on the need for judicial reform._

| Peter — Just a few years ago, the idea that someone like Donald Trump would be running for president (again!) would have been a joke. But he has a commanding lead in Arizona today. It’s hard to even think that someone like Kari Lake, one of Donald Trump’s most vocal supporters, could be a United States Senator after all of her lies, misinformation, conspiracies, schoolyard insults and bullying. But the polls have this U.S. Senate race a dead-heat, and we are losing our edge in fundraising right now. Both of them have to go through Ruben Gallego to win, but to defend Arizona he needs your help. And these next few days before our final FEC deadline before the election are some of the most critically important days of the campaign. Ruben is legally required to publicly report his fundraising numbers after this FEC deadline. Everyone is going to be watching, because what happens in this race directly affects what happens up and down the ballot in Arizona. If we put up a strong FEC report we improve our chances at defending our Senate Majority and winning back the White House. If we put up a weak FEC report it invites millions more dollars in outside spending and throws the momentum back to Kari Lake and Trump. We need a TON of donations before this FEC deadline to catch up to where we need to be. It would be an unmitigated disaster if we miss our goals this late in the election. | | Friend, I got a few free minutes this morning, with no meetings and calls. It’s a gift to have even a moment to spare with a campaign to run and the chaos of life. I wanted to take this moment to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.The truth is, when I jumped in this race, I had no idea how things were going to go. I’m not a career politician and in what has become a one-1600D&utm;_tc=1600D-20240922rty state, we were just hoping to finish in the top two in the March primary election against three democrat candidates.But things have changed. Adam Schiff is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our country down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about the quality of life for Californians who are facing rampant crime, homelessness, drug addiction, inflation, failing school systems, and open borders chaos.Adam Schiff doesn’t care about Californians – he's just obsessed with taking down Republicans.And if he wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for California and the country. He’s dangerous. Really.He's also been raising a ton of money from his unhinged ramblings, and that’s extremely concerning. I’ll be honest, this is one of the toughest races in the country. But, with your help we can save the soul of California and start a Republican come back throughout the U.S.One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits, we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.If we’re going to defeat Adam Schiff, protect millions of Californians and start the nationwide Republican comeback rally, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.So, please:Can you make a $6 contribution to my campaign today? The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. It’s going to add up fast when a ton of people chip in together.

name: Gabriel Llanes
subject: Time is Running Out
body:
| | | |
---
Friend,
September 30th is quickly approaching, and we need your help to finish the quarter strong. Our opponent has been in Washington for almost fifteen years and has a warchest built up by special interests and the D.C. elite.
Our campaign has been capturing national attention recently and our volunteers are hard at work hitting doors and making phone calls, but [we need additional reinforcements ](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0011hnavqky9i9UWMrrrTbpBELUC3guTVtNbPTqLAZIujgO_N7OQsc4JvivZAs6L9zHuL-Q1iWBJEhNaT23qgG7qlmMtqPGB1gXmTawrW8K6asSv3sMNdiXzHhrUmHUpfM2ln0GaHyY7ltK80mB5LKyMDEAa0elSIVcHdjuankMz3q2ZlBpvdQOnfWQEUrDETKVwOLCgB1Hslg=&c=E_igZqEUJ424zJ_JKgLMplcfVuzSH7_gu-b2XCrZkRV6ZoPZfSHf8g==&ch=siOBZqnJmvfQ8PLU-Fzi3piNPd5NBNZK816S15RhulBmQdyRF3wznA==)so we can help put an end to a career politician.
I'll get right to the point: we are planning a massive push in the next few weeks to help send a common sense, small business owner and teacher to Washington D.C.
My friend, Jerry Evans, is that person. Jerry has committed to balancing the budget, lowering inflation, keeping our streets safe, securing the border and having compassionate policies for the less fortunate. Jerry has also committed to bringing back vocational training to our schools along with making sure kids have the tools to find high-paying jobs of the future.
Jerry will do this because he has committed to not only pushing for term limits, but he plans to only be in Washington for a short while and return home to the community that he loves so he can raise his three children and run his small business.
So consider helping us end the fundraising quarter strong [by chipping in $10, $25, $50 or more](https://4ghhthgbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0011hnavqky9i9UWMrrrTbpBELUC3guTVtNbPTqLAZIujgO_N7OQsc4JvivZAs6L9zHuL-Q1iWBJEhNaT23qgG7qlmMtqPGB1gXmTawrW8K6asSv3sMNdiXzHhrUmHUpfM2ln0GaHyY7ltK80mB5LKyMDEAa0elSIVcHdjuankMz3q2ZlBpvdQOnfWQEUrDETKVwOLCgB1Hslg=&c=E_igZqEUJ424zJ_JKgLMplcfVuzSH7_gu-b2XCrZkRV6ZoPZfSHf8g==&ch=siOBZqnJmvfQ8PLU-Fzi3piNPd5NBNZK816S15RhulBmQdyRF3wznA==) so we can put an end to a career politician.
For Freedom and Liberty,
Gabriel R. Llanes Senior Advisor Jerry Evans for Congress

| | Hi Friend,
---
Last night, I voted to temporarily end the brinkmanship and avoid a government shutdown.
---
Unfortunately, it’s not the first time in my year in Congress — and we run the risk of being on the brink of shutdown again in late December.
---
The dysfunctional, chaotic House Republicans came very close to shutting down our government on the eve of this consequential election. For the sake of unserious, meaningless, and divisive policy provisions, House Republicans were willing to risk economic disruption to families across the country.
---
But yet again, my fellow Democrats and I put country over party affiliation to provide the votes needed to keep the government open — an essential function of our Congress. We know it’s time to end this brinkmanship and remain committed to fighting extremism whenever necessary. That’s what I’m hoping voters choose by voting for me this year.
---
I know you’re getting lots of emails. I won’t be over the top in my words, but I have a **big deadline on Sunday**. It’s the last end-of-quarter reporting period before the election on November 5th.
---
**[**I hope you will stand with me and House Democrats to solve problems for hard-working Americans and deliver real results to move our country forward. All of your contributions will help my campaign and help me support key campaigns around the country. **](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93613386/501061919/570291875?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU0NTUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDllOWYyNmUtMTE3Yy1lZjExLTg0NzMtNjA0NWJkYThhYTM0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=LIYca5uA6E7DhR5mfP-Cjnq0AMhSJMVrHX0WU-DyOYg=)**

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
Bombshell Indictment: NYC Mayor Eric Adams Charged in Federal Court (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/bombshell-indictment-nyc-mayor-eric-adams-charged-in-federal-court.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=83598fa881-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/bombshell-indictment-nyc-mayor-eric-adams-charged-in-federal-court.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=83598fa881-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
By Illinois Review

New York City Mayor Eric Adams, a close ally of Kamala Harris and once seen as a rising star in the Democratic Party, now finds himself at the center of a federal corruption scandal. Indicted by a grand jury, Adams faces serious allegations that could end his political career. The charges stem from claims that his 2021 mayoral campaign received illegal donations from the Turkish government. This indictment has rocked New York City, throwing the mayor’s office into chaos and leading many to question whether the city is on the same path as Chicago under Brandon Johnson.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/bombshell-indictment-nyc-mayor-eric-adams-charged-in-federal-court.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=83598fa881-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Adams’ indictment comes after months of federal raids on his top aides and fundraising team. The FBI seized electronic devices, text messages, and other communications as part of their investigation into possible straw donor schemes involving foreign governments. Federal agents have raided the homes of several key City Hall staffers, all while Adams maintains his innocence. The mayor has claimed he’s the target of political attacks, but the scale and depth of the investigation suggest something much more serious.

I hope you’ll take a moment to hear why I think it’s so important to invest in our state legislatures. The Republican Party’s agenda threatens all of us – they’re coming for abortion access, voting rights, LGBTQ+ rights, gun safety laws, health care, and more. name: GIFFORDS
subject: [BREAKING] President Biden just took MONUMENTAL action to save lives from gun violence
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
This is a day that will go down in history for our gun safety movement
#

**This is BIG news: President Biden and Vice President Harris just announced brand new executive orders and actions that will save countless lives from gun violence.**
These new directives will:
* Establish an Emerging Firearms Threats Task Force to investigate emerging gun technology like conversion devices and 3D-printed guns
* Expand background checks
* Provide more funding for states to implement extreme risk protection orders, also known as “red flag laws”
* Invest in America’s schools
* Enhance reporting on ghost guns and gun trafficking
* Improve and expand data collection and reporting on shootings and gunshot injuries

President Biden has been the strongest gun safety president we have **_ever**_ had, and Vice President Harris has been doing an **_excellent**_ job leading the White House Office of Gun Violence Prevention since its founding one year ago. We applaud their leadership on this issue.
Many of the actions President Biden released today are based on recommendations we made to the incoming Biden-Harris administration in November 2020, and are what we have been advocating for since our founding in 2013. We are so glad the administration understands that these are monumental steps forward that have the power to keep people from dying from preventable gun violence.
This is a day that will go down in history for our gun safety movement, and none of this progress would have been possible without supporters like you. But we can’t slow down now. The work isn’t finished yet.
[**So please, in honor of today’s historic executive actions from the Biden-Harris administration, will you chip in $3 to GIFFORDS PAC to help us keep moving forward in our work to end our nation’s gun violence epidemic once and for all?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240926-1-30&t=1&akid=9032%2E3935704%2EUfRXBo)

name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12709157?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| Friends and Neighbors,

Thank you for joining me for this week’s newsletter! It is always a pleasure to share more with you about my work and efforts to make our state and district even better. As always, please do not hesitate to reach out to me if there is anything I can do for you. I would be honored to work together to address the real challenges facing our community. You can get in touch with my office by [clicking here](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=eafda90980&e=d1c1b9864f).**** We would be more than happy to assist you in any way we can!
---
| | **Tour of the New College of Central Florida Nursing Building**
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
| I had the opportunity to join Rep. Stan McClain to tour the new College of Central Florida nursing building, which was made possible by appropriations secured during the legislative session. Thank you to College of Central Florida President Henningsen for taking the time to show us around the facility. It is always remarkable to see what can be accomplished through partnerships. We were there for the groundbreaking ceremony last year and are excited to attend the ribbon-cutting event next year.
---
| | **Check Presentation at the Nancy Renyhart Center**
---
|
---
| It was a pleasure to present a check to the Nancy Renyhart Center to help fund Dementia Education by Representative Stan McClain and Senator Keith Perry. This funding will greatly assist in educating the public and ensuring those affected are kept informed. Thank you to Rep. McClain and Sen. Perry for championing this in our state legislature.
---
| | **Give4Marion Celebration Party**
---
|
---
---
| It was an honor to attend the Give4Marion Celebration Party. They were able to raise $3,019,483 to help nonprofits in our community. A huge shout out to the Rock Program for not only reaching their goal but surpassing it by $102,660. This amazing organization does so much good for Marion County, so it is not surprising that they have the support of many kind and generous people in our community.
---
| | **Tour of the Estella Byrd Whitman Community Health Center**
---
|
---
---
| I had the pleasure of touring the Estella Byrd Whitman Community Health Center. Under their leadership team, the center is doing incredible things for our community on the west side of Ocala. They offer accessible primary care and health education for so many, and I look forward to continuing to support them and the great partnership that we have.
---
| | **Tours of Hillcrest School and Forest High School**
---
|
---
---
| Thank you to Nancy Thrower, Chair of the Marion County School Board, for taking me around Hillcrest School and Forest High School. I was able to meet leadership staff from both schools and hear about the great things they are doing.
---
| | **Press Conference Held by Lt. Governor Nuñez to Promote Water Safety**
---
|
---
---
| I had the honor of attending a press conference held by Lt. Governor Nuñez to promote water safety. The ability to swim is a luxury that many of us have, but it can be dangerous if not taken seriously, especially for younger children. The number one precaution for preventing these accidents is swim lessons. During the last legislative session, we were able to create and pass the swimming lesson voucher program, and it has officially launched. The application portal is now live, and you can visit [w](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=f78eb19157&e=d1c1b9864f)[atersmartf](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=2ca5c68cb9&e=d1c1b9864f)[l.com](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=ff613dcd58&e=d1c1b9864f) to learn more. A huge shout out to Lt. Governor Nuñez for championing this project and coming out to the Florida Aquatic Swimming and Training facility in Ocala. Also, thank you to Ken Colen for making your vision come to life through FAST. [Florida Aquatics Swimming Training (floridafast.com)](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=3fa138890f&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
|
---
| | Thank you for reading, and I look forward to sharing with you again soon.

May God bless you and the Free State of Florida!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

State Representative Ryan Chamberlin

1101 The Capitol
402 South Monroe Street
Tallahassee, FL 32399-1300

You can [update your preferences](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/profile?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=929c76fdea&e=d1c1b9864f&c=74d2acf363) or [unsubscribe from this list](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=929c76fdea&t=b&e=d1c1b9864f&c=74d2acf363).

## **Dispatches from the frontlines**
---
Peter,The July 7th, 2016 mass shooting of Dallas police officers marked a turning point in my life. The deaths of those officers, compounded by the recent deaths of two Black men at the hands of police, left me deeply troubled. The aftermath forced me to confront questions that had been lurking beneath the surface for years about race, violence, and medicine. **Suddenly thrust into the national spotlight, I found myself speaking publicly for the first time about the harsh realities I witnessed daily in the trauma bay –– while questioning my purpose as a doctor.**
---
| | [](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66f5752c01e0b86955f7cbee&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.broadleafbooks.com%2Fstore%2Fproduct%2F9781506483122%2FThe-Bodies-Keep-Coming&w=5ec4204c9456be6adcb47e64&c=b_66f55c1e0eeda24f968fb221&l=en-US&s=tNOq7B4BmXt9K--Rh3u6Y-ztBgA%3D) |
---|---|---
_**The Bodies Keep Coming**_**
** This book began as a few hundred stream-of-consciousness words I thumb-typed on my phone after a session with my therapist. Over the ensuing years, the document spent days, weeks, and sometimes months unopened, while morphing into something greater than I planned. **I laid myself bare in the book, sharing my stories from the frontlines, hoping to inspire you to take action.**
---

Peter,

[**Today, World Contraception Day, is a moment to remind ourselves that contraception is a human right.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93619237/501074870/1124227485?utm_campaign=25emage-0910aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=triple&sourceid=1149851&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2Q5YTQyNi0xNzdjLWVmMTEtODQ3My02MDQ1YmRhOGFhMzQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=13WYkgd5kbe-9P2yUFG84ocSY6JVvoyuJVIcoHjP7FQ=&emci=b14135d9-9077-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=07d9a426-177c-ef11-8473-6045bda8aa34&ceid=954237) **Each year, contraception prevents hundreds of thousands of pregnancy-related deaths. It's an essential tool that empowers individuals to make choices about their lives, including whether and when to have children.**

But as anti-abortion extremists wage global attacks not just on abortion but on contraception, assisted reproduction, and gender equality writ large, it is clear _they believe women and girls don't deserve the right to control their own lives and futures._ | [**PROTECT CONTRACEPTION**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93619239/501074872/1124227485?utm_campaign=25emage-0910aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=triple&sourceid=1149851&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2Q5YTQyNi0xNzdjLWVmMTEtODQ3My02MDQ1YmRhOGFhMzQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=13WYkgd5kbe-9P2yUFG84ocSY6JVvoyuJVIcoHjP7FQ=&emci=b14135d9-9077-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=07d9a426-177c-ef11-8473-6045bda8aa34&ceid=954237 "PROTECT CONTRACEPTION")
---
The United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) has chosen this year's World Contraception Day theme, "A choice for all. Freedom to plan, power to choose," to highlight the urgent need for universal access to contraception. Yet, millions of people around the world still face barriers that make it difficult to access birth control, and growing anti-rights movements are fighting to make it even more so.

Over the years, the Center for Reproductive Rights has fought fiercely to expand access to high-quality, affordable, and accessible contraception. _And we have won momentous victories,_ from overturning FDA restrictions on emergency contraceptives like Plan B, to helping reverse a 13-year-long ban on emergency contraception in Honduras. But our work isn’t done.

An estimated 257 million women worldwide lack access to modern contraceptives, increasing their risk of unintended pregnancies, unsafe abortions, and preventable maternal deaths. **Complications from pregnancy and childbirth are among the leading causes of death for girls aged 15-19 globally.**

clean_body: Marking World Contraception Day | | | ---|--- Peter, Each year, contraception prevents hundreds of thousands of pregnancy-related deaths. It's an essential tool that empowers individuals to make choices about their lives, including whether and when to have children. But as anti-abortion extremists wage global attacks not just on abortion but on contraception, assisted reproduction, and gender equality writ large, it is clear they believe women and girls don't deserve the right to control their own lives and futures. | "PROTECT CONTRACEPTION" The United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) has chosen this year's World Contraception Day theme, "A choice for all. Freedom to plan, power to choose," to highlight the urgent need for universal access to contraception. Yet, millions of people around the world still face barriers that make it difficult to access birth control, and growing anti-rights movements are fighting to make it even more so. Over the years, the Center for Reproductive Rights has fought fiercely to expand access to high-quality, affordable, and accessible contraception. And we have won momentous victories, from overturning FDA restrictions on emergency contraceptives like Plan B, to helping reverse a 13-year-long ban on emergency contraception in Honduras. But our work isn’t done. An estimated 257 million women worldwide lack access to modern contraceptives, increasing their risk of unintended pregnancies, unsafe abortions, and preventable maternal deaths. Complications from pregnancy and childbirth are among the leading causes of death for girls aged 15-19 globally. Your support can make all the difference. Every dollar helps us fight back against extremist attacks and expand access to safe, reliable contraception worldwide. "FIGHT BACK WITH A TRIPLED GIFT" Onward, Nancy Northup President & CEO P.S. If you or someone you love has ever used contraception, you understand the power of making decisions about your body and your future. Donate today to ensure everyone has that same right to bodily autonomy. This is about equal treatment in our democracy and equal treatment for all citizens, regardless of skin color, financial resources, or background. A rich person shouldn't be able to buy their vote back, candidate for office or not.
Add your name today to end this double standard: Tell Congress to co-sponsor and pass the Inclusive Democracy Act now >> [https://act.commoncause.org/letters/tell-congress-end-shameful-double-standards-in-our-legal-system?source=090224swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]

Folks:
Listen, the honest truth is: Felony disenfranchisement laws have a shameful history dating back to Jim Crow – and were never intended to target wealthy, powerful people. These laws were expressly written to make it harder for someone who had ever committed a crime to vote, even if they had repaid their debt to society.
These laws impact 4.4 million ordinary Americans currently disenfranchised by felony convictions and unable to vote.
The Inclusive Democracy Act would end this blatant double standard , restoring full voting rights for federal elections to all Americans with felony convictions, and ensuring NO American is denied their right to have a say in our democracy.
Sign our petition now: Tell Congress it's time to end shameful double standards in our legal system >> [https://act.commoncause.org/letters/tell-congress-end-shameful-double-standards-in-our-legal-system?source=090224swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-actions]

Why are we talking about a double standard? One huge example:
Despite his 34 felony convictions, Donald Trump doesn’t have to worry about his eligibility to vote this fall. He has the wealth, connections, and privilege to ensure his voting rights would never be in question – not to mention a high-powered legal team paid for by his political donors due to gaps in campaign finance laws.
Just look at Trump’s home state of Florida, where Governor Ron DeSantis has personally guaranteed that the former president will be able to cast a ballot this fall. In stark contrast, Black Florida residents have been dragged from their homes at gunpoint and arrested for the "crime" of not realizing they were ineligible to vote .
It’s time to END this shameful double standard. Cheers,

Brian

The most important item on the ballot (especially for conservatives) is to _**vote NO on Prop 1**_ and urge everyone you know to do the same.

Our elections aren't broken and don't need any "fixes." _The candidate with the most votes should win, plain and simple._ We don’t need a leftist voting scheme controlled by vote-switching computer algorithms ruining our state. Finding information on the judges is and always has been very difficult. Surprisingly, there's little available, and I've yet to find anything substantial (please let me know if you have any info on any of them I can share). name: Tom Fitton
subject: We’re Getting to the Bottom of This Scandal!
body:
The crises surrounding the U.S. Secret Service seem to worsen by the week...and Judicial Watch is leading the way in finding out why.

| | |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

The crises surrounding the U.S. Secret Service seem to worsen by the week...and Judicial Watch is leading the way in finding out _why_.
Back on July 13, an assassination attempt on Donald Trump wounded the former president and killed an innocent bystander in Butler, Pennsylvania.
We filed multiple Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests with the U.S. Secret Service about this attack and reports that the Secret Service had denied requests for additional protection at Trump rallies...and when we were stonewalled, _we filed a lawsuit in federal court to get to the facts about the Secret Service 's epic failure in Pennsylvania_.
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70338&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Then, on September 15, the Secret Service apprehended an armed gunman who was just 400 yards from former President Trump as he was playing golf at his golf course in Florida... _and it appears the gunman had been in and around the golf course for nearly 12 hours before he was arrested_!

Right now, we are preparing our FOIA requests... _and probable lawsuits_ ....to find out how and why the Secret Service again seems to have _again_ dropped the ball in protecting a man who is both a former president _and_ a leading candidate for president in this year's election

**[And that is why I am counting on you to help us with a special contribution today!**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70338&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70338&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

The Biden-Harris administration is in full cover-up mode about these failures of the Secret Service to do its job...and the mainstream media, after a flurry of coverage in the immediate aftermath of the events in Pennsylvania and Florida, has gone silent on them.

But that's not the way Judicial Watch operates!

The American people _deserve to know how_ the Secret Service could be so inept...and they _deserve to know why_ repeated requests for increased protection of Trump and his campaign rallies were denied.

Our FOIA requests and lawsuit are _not_ about politics...they are about the American people's right to know what a vital agency of our government is... _and is not_ ...doing!

But this litigation is time-consuming, and it is expensive...and that is why I hope you will decide to help us today with [a generous tax-deductible gift.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70338&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70338&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Our work has already uncovered records that show the Secret Service has made it a top priority that "diversity and inclusion is not just 'talked about' - but demonstrated by all employees through '_Every Action, Every Day._ '" This demonstrates that the Secret Service, for years, has seemed to place woke politics over their protection and law enforcement mission.

name: PoliticsPA
subject: PA flips the script on election trust
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

This segment dives into **election integrity** , emphasizing transparency, uniformity, and trust in the electoral process with expert insights.

Pennsylvania's Secretary of the Commonwealth **Al Schmidt** and**** Senior Advisor on Election Administration from the Committee of Seventy, **Jeff Greenburg,** shared views and insights you won't want to miss ahead of the upcoming election.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **Secretary of the Commonwealth, Al Schmidt **acknowledged challenges in setting uniform county standards for dropboxes, noting, "Counties know their voters better than we do," and while all follow the same election code, specifics like dropbox regulation are "for the legislature to decide."
[[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=63cc6ed133&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Former Dauphin County Election Director, Jerry Feaser **stated, "there are a lot of things that need to be cleaned up to make a more uniform election," citing major discrepancies in handling mail-in ballots, provisional ballots, ballot boxes, and regular ballot envelopes. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=fb4a308d25&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Voting Reform_
* A substantial 77% of Pennsylvanians support **requiring county voting officials to contact voters about errors** on submitted ballots.
* Voters are split, with **50% supporting pre-canvassing** of mail-in ballots.
* 73% of voters favor **requiring photo IDs** to vote.
* 65% of voters support **automatic voter registration**. [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=39ab1e2fbc&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Public Opinion_
* **Only 40%, or two in five registered voters** in Pennsylvania, are satisfied with how democracy functions in the United States. [[F&M Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=b07cc90bb3&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Elections_
* In the latest Muhlenberg College/Morning Call poll, **Donald Trump and Kamala Harris are tied in a dead heat at 48% each** for Pennsylvania's 19 Electoral College votes. [[Muhlenberg Poll](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a542658505&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **The Future of Election Trust Nationwide Runs Through PA**
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e012117686&e=b7b3eddce2 "We Need to Fix Trust in Elections – Here's How | Voices of Reason Ep. 4")
---
|
---
|
* * *
---
| **Coming Up...**
---
|
---
| The Keystone Candidate Forum is a collaborative series hosted by _Voices of Reason_ , sponsored by the PA Chamber of Business & Industry.

Our goal: **everyone gets a fair shake in the Keystone Candidate Forum** with the belief that balanced dialogue provides every candidate an unfettered platform to share their views.

The forum spotlights competitive races across Pennsylvania, including statewide elections and key swing districts that could shift the balance of power in the state legislature.

Airing from September through October, the forum will stream online and be broadcast across the Philadelphia metropolitan area, with detailed recaps featured in the _Voices of Reason_ newsletter.
_In Case You Missed It..._

_Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=aece3d2b1a&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=629a88a1d7&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=294307ee2b&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=bb7726b784&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=46662a20a2&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.

Visit the _Voice of Reason_ [YouTube page](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=71d38249dc&e=b7b3eddce2) to experience all the great moments you missed.

| | | | Friends,

Our servicemen and women are experiencing a food crisis, with 26% of our military facing food insecurity, 14% of which are on food assistance programs. To highlight the issue, With Honor Action and members of the bipartisan For Country Caucus gathered on the National Mall this week, [to organize a flag demonstration](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=5228dac060&e=33f53a5b1a), and raise awareness for nearly 325,000 active duty military service members who currently struggle with food insecurity, an issue that also greatly impacts our military recruitment and retention crisis as well.

During the event, participants [placed 325 American flags](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=2fef08864e&e=33f53a5b1a) in the grass across from the Washington Monument, each one representing 1,000 troops.
---
| [ ](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=505f2d5b22&e=33f53a5b1a)
---
| Earlier this year, With Honor Action strongly supported a proposed pay raise of up to 19.5% for troops ranked E-4 and below to go into effect next year as a step to help combat food insecurity. While this won’t fix the whole problem, this is a huge step in bringing relief to military families who should never have to worry about going hungry.

To learn more about what With Honor Action is doing on this topic and other military quality of life issues, check out our [website here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=4a33e40429&e=33f53a5b1a).

name: Carolina at United We Dream Action
subject: Our FAQ:
body:
Maybe you’ve been wondering about some of these! | | | Peter, I want to answer some of our most frequently asked questions about United We Dream Action — I hope you’ll take just a few moments to read on:
1. **What is United We Dream Action?**
United We Dream Action (UWDA) is the largest immigrant-youth led organization in the nation, organizing for the future we want to see for ourselves and our immigrant communities.
2. **What does UWDA work on?**
**UWDA is committed to fighting against disinformation, holding our elected officials accountable, breaking up ICE and the deportation machine, and advocating for a path to citizenship for all 11 million undocumented immigrants.** We plan weeks of action, trainings, rallies, textbanks, letter writing campaigns and more, all in pursuit of our goals.
3. **Why should I donate to UWDA?**
We rely on donations we receive from emails just like this one to fund our advocacy and electoral campaigns. Rallies, reaching voters, and getting the attention of politicians take resources — and that’s where your donations can fill the gap.
**Peter****, we don’t expect you to chip in every time we ask. # My Opponent Needs To Go!
---
| Dear Peter,
---
| | | | | | | | | | | I am writing you today as the Top Two Candidate in CD15 because it’s time for change. In the latest bipartisan vote that successfully passed in Congress, known as H.R. 7909, my opponent made the troubling decision to vote **NOT** to deport illegal aliens who have committed acts of violence against women, even in cases where they were convicted!
How can we feel safe and secure in our own homes when our elected Incumbent fails to take the necessary steps to protect us? This is deeply concerning and raises serious questions about his commitment to our safety. Actions speak louder than words; therefore, I urge you to examine closely how he voted on other critical issues that impact our community. The time to act is at the voting booth.

I met Tim Walz on my first day in Congress. We became friends, going on early morning runs (in the dead of DC winter, when I was bundled in layers, he was wearing a t-shirt and shorts), meeting up to see Bruce Springsteen and sharing stories about our families and hometowns. For six years, I sat next to him on the Veterans Affairs Committee. He was the first person in the room and the last to leave. No one fought harder for veterans. And he did it by bringing Democrats and Republicans together to get the job done. As Governor of Minnesota, he protected reproductive rights, implemented background checks on guns, passed paid family leave, defended voting rights and invested more than $1 billion in affordable housing. Not bad. And before any of this, he was a beloved high school teacher, a championship-winning football coach and a 24-year veteran of the Army National Guard. Put simply: _Tim is one of the best people I've ever had the pleasure to know and I could not be more excited that he is on the ticket._ I am energized to do everything I can to help Vice President Harris and Governor Walz win the most important election of our lives. I met Tim Walz on my first day in Congress. body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| [ ](http://trk.libertyledger._c2M9MDA1ODVOMDI0Mkw5VERPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPW5vdGVjYXJkc19wcmVtaXVtJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFFLUxMTzU1NDI0In0/i5vIXAa7m2Qe3OQ3vGRgFw) Friend of Liberty, I have a special gift for you--a set of unique notecards featuring pictures of the "Liberty Walk" statues found on the Hillsdale College campus. These beautiful cards include _George Washington_ and _Thomas Jefferson_ ... _Abraham Lincoln_ and _Frederick Douglass_ ... _Winston Churchill_ , _Margaret Thatcher_ , and _Ronald Reagan_. _All of these statues stand proudly on Hillsdale 's Michigan campus_--one of the only institutions of higher learning that refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. You can view the cards at this secure link: [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/get-your-liberty-walk-notecards](http://trk.libertyledger._c2M9MDA1ODVOMDI0Mkw5VERPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPW5vdGVjYXJkc19wcmVtaXVtJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFFLUxMTzU1NDI0In0/9s1kYZcZJV1g9CFBtD9kOA) Let the cards serve as a reminder to you of the vigilance and commitment needed to defend liberty--especially right now, a critical time for our country. **Sadly, several polls and events around the country show that increasing numbers of young Americans are being drawn to socialism and other ideas destructive of liberty. ** And the unrest in communities nationwide, where statues of our Founding Fathers are being vandalized or torn down, is another symptom of this underlying disease. What explains this development? As an educator and president of Hillsdale, I've been thinking about this for a long time. Here's one primary reason... For decades, the "progressive" leftist academics who became dominant in most of America's colleges and universities after the 1960s have been teaching a **biased** and **distorted** view of American history. _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project" is a prime example. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom, but slavery--and the Project's main goal is to inject this false teaching into the curricula of America's K-12 schools. Imagine young minds in classrooms all over American learning this. Does it make you as concerned as it does me? And given this trend in American education, is it any wonder that our young people feel less of a patriotic attachment to our nation and are increasingly attracted--out of ignorance--to failed ideas such as socialism, ideas that are destructive of liberty? Another sign of the "progressive" Left's influence is the continuing attempt to erase our American heritage by destroying monuments, renaming schools and streets, and censoring works of literature in the name of "political correctness." The Left knows that it cannot remake society according to its ever-evolving idea of "progress" until it has "canceled" patriotism and hallowed out the idea that we should be grateful for our blessings to the great men and women of the past--many of whom are depicted on the cards I'd like to send you. **This is why we are engaging the Left on the battlefield of education ... and why your generous support is needed right away. ** After all, those on the Left are extremely well-funded, thanks to liberal billionaires like George Soros and his ilk. **With the support of citizens like you --citizens who understand the importance of education to liberty--we are ramping up its outreach efforts on behalf of liberty, especially to our nation's youth.** It is even more urgent that we do so in the face of efforts such as _ The New York Times_' "1619 Project" that undermine patriotism and lead to an increased pull toward socialism. Hillsdale is the only educational institution in America that is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens of all ages, from coast to coast, about America's great heritage of liberty. **Your generous support today will... **
* **Expand** the circulation of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty, to reach millions more Americans (you can also receive a free subscription of _Imprimis_ ...for life).

* **Send** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to schools across America, and to members of our armed forces, who have sworn to defend the Constitution.

* **Increase** the number of citizens (especially younger Americans) enrolling in Hillsdale's free online courses such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope."

* **Launch** and support more and more Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 charter schools nationwide, returning excellence to American K-12 education and impacting thousands of our youngest citizens.

One other thing you should be aware of... Hello,
When my husband Adam Frisch ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, we were the underdogs until the very end.
Adam did not receive any national support. We were heavily out-raised and out-spent by Boebert and her Washington allies.
Ultimately, though, Adam lost in a recount by just 546 votes – the closest race in the entire country.
The worst part is that it wasn’t because we didn’t work hard. Our family, our team, and our volunteers gave it everything we had. We just ran out of money.
In the final weeks of the race, we had to cut back. Right as Boebert was increasing her advertising – right as we _knew_ we were on her heels – we had to pull TV ads, cancel digital buys, and make a lot of hard budget decisions.
Adam might not say it, but I will: If we had had additional resources and been able to fully fund his campaign until the end, Adam would probably be in Congress right now – and Lauren Boebert would be a footnote in a history book.
It’s part of why Adam announced so early that he was running again. We needed to make sure that we have the money to build a campaign that can sustain all the way through to November 5, 2024.
But with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this race is a lot harder. The Super PACs are already attacking Adam, and he’s not taking any money from corporate PACs. If he is going to win this critical House seat, Adam needs grassroots donors like you to chip in right now:

clean_body: Adam might not say it, but I will. Hello, When my husband Adam Frisch ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, we were the underdogs until the very end. Adam did not receive any national support. We were heavily out-raised and out-spent by Boebert and her Washington allies. Ultimately, though, Adam lost in a recount by just 546 votes – the closest race in the entire country. The worst part is that it wasn’t because we didn’t work hard. Our family, our team, and our volunteers gave it everything we had. We just ran out of money. In the final weeks of the race, we had to cut back. Right as Boebert was increasing her advertising – right as we knew we were on her heels – we had to pull TV ads, cancel digital buys, and make a lot of hard budget decisions. Adam might not say it, but I will: If we had had additional resources and been able to fully fund his campaign until the end, Adam would probably be in Congress right now – and Lauren Boebert would be a footnote in a history book. It’s part of why Adam announced so early that he was running again. We needed to make sure that we have the money to build a campaign that can sustain all the way through to November 5, 2024. But with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this race is a lot harder. The Super PACs are already attacking Adam, and he’s not taking any money from corporate PACs. If he is going to win this critical House seat, Adam needs grassroots donors like you to chip in right now: = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = From our entire family, thank you. **WHERE:** Lloyd 700 Building (700 NE Multnomah Street, Portland, OR 97232), 3rd floor conference room or via Zoom [**RSVP here!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93632872/501115134/1379144139?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImMzZWQ0OTkxLTI0N2MtZWYxMS04NDczLTYwNDViZGE4YWEzNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LlhITcCq_sxAWak-ju-_6Q6SDLNeYdWGypwJNcGQqxo=&emci=bea5eeae-8f7b-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=c3ed4991-247c-ef11-8473-6045bda8aa34&ceid=2107230) If you can’t attend the hearing tonight, no problem. You can still make your voice heard by sending DEQ a message today. [**Will you send a message now? **](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93632873/501115135/699690731?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImMzZWQ0OTkxLTI0N2MtZWYxMS04NDczLTYwNDViZGE4YWEzNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LlhITcCq_sxAWak-ju-_6Q6SDLNeYdWGypwJNcGQqxo=&emci=bea5eeae-8f7b-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=c3ed4991-247c-ef11-8473-6045bda8aa34&ceid=2107230) Thank you for joining OLCV in fighting for a healthy future and a stable climate for all! Sincerely,
Eliza Walton
OLCV Coalition Director | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93632874/501115139/699690731?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImMzZWQ0OTkxLTI0N2MtZWYxMS04NDczLTYwNDViZGE4YWEzNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LlhITcCq_sxAWak-ju-_6Q6SDLNeYdWGypwJNcGQqxo=&emci=bea5eeae-8f7b-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=c3ed4991-247c-ef11-8473-6045bda8aa34&ceid=2107230)Hi Peter, As you may have seen from our previous emails, right now Oregon has an opportunity to protect a healthy climate future and deliver justice for communities by restoring our cornerstone Climate Protection Program (CPP). [**Will you help restore the CPP today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/93632878/501115143/1379144139?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImMzZWQ0OTkxLTI0N2MtZWYxMS04NDczLTYwNDViZGE4YWEzNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LlhITcCq_sxAWak-ju-_6Q6SDLNeYdWGypwJNcGQqxo=&emci=bea5eeae-8f7b-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=c3ed4991-247c-ef11-8473-6045bda8aa34&ceid=2107230) The Oregon Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) opened a comment period in August, and has since **extended the deadline to September 27th**. DEQ needs your input on its proposed rules to restore the CPP, a vital program which will cut fossil fuel emissions 90% by 2050, and invest upwards of $150 million annually in clean energy projects for frontline Oregon communities most impacted by climate damage. Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: My grandparents’ sacrifices
