clean_body: ...and how you can help protect it Dear Peter, Where evergreen meets ocean blue, you’ll find a California original: the redwood forests of the Sonoma Coast. This rugged wilderness is one of the treasured few of its kind — an area rich in history, biodiversity, and unmatched beauty. Sonoma Coast Redwoods is home to some of the oldest second-growth redwoods in the range, standing guard for hundreds of years, side-by-side with new-growth trees, young saplings and old-growth mother trees. Save the Redwoods League is seeking to acquire and protect more than 1,600 acres along the California coast — but we need YOUR help. Sonoma Coast Redwoods is of the highest conservation priority because of its incredible carbon-storage potential. Reconnecting these lands to the larger redwood corridor would secure the region’s redwood footprint — and protect the Sonoma Coast Redwoods property from harmful development. There are those who would love to build homes and private estates here. But we cannot let that happen. What’s at Stake & Why Your Support Matters Now: | Conservation: Some redwoods are up to 1,000 years old, while others are just saplings. This age diversity is a sign of a healthy, resilient forest. ---|--- | Climate: This 1,624-acre property includes 836 acres of redwood forest, providing crucial carbon sequestration, creating clean air, and boosting wildfire resilience for the entire region. ---|--- | Culture: As the ancestral territory of the Kashia Band of Pomo Indians, the Sonoma Coast Redwoods has a rich cultural history. ---|--- | Community: These forests provide a buffer to nearby state parks, connecting and expanding public and recreational access along the Sonoma Coast for the nearly 2 million people who live within 50 miles of the property. ---|--- Protecting the Sonoma Coast Redwoods would secure our past, enrich the present, and safeguard our future with critical climate benefits. Redwood forests are vital to local wildlife and enjoyed and treasured by forest lovers like you and me. Thank you for putting your passion for our forests into action. Sincerely, | Jeff Stump Director of Land Protection ---|--- P.S. Sonoma Coast Redwoods is truly breathtaking — but it is also breath giving , providing clean air that benefits the millions who live and work here. | ---|--- Connect with us | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States |

**⇨ ****18% of Spanish-speaking domestic workers were jobless in August** , a sharp increase from previous months. Many are struggling to find work and provide for their families.
**⇨ ****52% of domestic workers who did find jobs earned less than $15 per hour** , far below a living wage.
**⇨ ****68% of surveyed workers were underemployed** , unable to find enough clients to make ends meet.
**⇨ ****83% of these workers faced food insecurity in August alone** , meaning they often didn’t know where their next meal would come from.
**⇨ ****55% of these workers faced housing insecurity in August** , meaning they often could not afford to pay their rent or mortgage or may be temporarily staying with friends or family, staying in shelters, or facing homelessness.

Sorry to be so blunt, but if we’re going to win in Arizona we cannot have bad days. We can’t miss our goals. And we absolutely can’t afford to have a prolonged slowdown like the one we’re in right now.
#

Peter, we’re at a bit of a loss here.
We’ve tried explaining the stakes of this election.
We’ve tried explaining how critical this FEC deadline at the end of the month is.
We’ve tried explaining how Arizona is the lynchpin we need to hold control of the U.S. Senate.
And we’ve tried over and over again to emphasize how dangerous, how damaging Kari Lake would be if she gained any more power and influence than she already has.
But still, our fundraising is down — not by a little bit, either. Ahead of arguably the most important deadline of the campaign, we’re having a tough time figuring out how we’re going to catch up on our goals. That’s happening at the exact moment that Kari Lake and her team are ramping up, that millions are pouring into Arizona against Ruben.
She’s raking in cash and she will use every dollar of it to beat us and impose her radical agenda.
Sorry to be so blunt, but if we’re going to win in Arizona, we cannot have bad days. We can’t miss our goals. And we absolutely can’t afford to have a prolonged slowdown like the one we’re in right now.

| | Current polling confirms Georgia is a battleground state, and every single vote is going to matter. But as we move closer to Election Day, it feels like roadblocks and barriers to accessing the ballot box and having our votes counted are increasing. Voter suppression tactics have become more aggressive as officials use administrative power to alter rules and limit voting access. Recent legislation passed in Georgia, like SB 202 and SB 189, fit together like a sinister right-wing web to suppress our votes. Right now, Fair Fight has our eyes set on the Georgia State Election Board, which currently has a Trump-endorsed majority. This board is changing rules close to the election, including new ballot counting rules that will slow down the process on election night. These rule changes cannot stand, and we won’t be intimidated by the number of threats that have risen. On the contrary, Fair Fight has been preparing for this election season — with help from supporters like you. We’re mobilizing against mass voter challenges and we’re preparing to turn out voters over the next six weeks. [**You help power this critical work to protect the right to vote, and I hope you know how incredibly grateful I am for your contributions.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93658525/501194722/801713560?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20240926_f_EOQPrimer_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzI4NzdkYi01MjdjLWVmMTEtODQ3My02MDQ1YmRhOGFhMzQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cLVdMBqiqF-ie4p0Uv_GWrGi8SvVyFdy7qcaGJURe5c=) It’s countdown to Election Day, and there’s still so much we need to do between now and November 5. We need your help to ensure fair elections, to support pro-voter candidates in crucial races, and to turn out the vote in unprecedented numbers. **Every action, no matter how small, contributes to our collective effort to protect voting rights and strengthen our democracy.** And remember, this election is not just about fighting _against_ something, it’s about fighting _for_ something — our freedom and our future. Larry Hogan’s super PAC just BLINDSIDED us with an $18 million ad blitz to try to defeat me. **With polling showing this battleground race tied, political experts are forecasting that the entire Senate majority could be decided here in Maryland.**

# _YOU Can Help Us Defeat Susie Lee!_
Want to help Drew and make sure Republicans maintain control of the House of Representatives? We need your help! This race is going to be tight, and having supporters like you step up and lend a hand is vital!

Here are the **_TOP 4_ ways _YOU_ can get involved:**

**1. Donate: **Simply chipping in a few dollars to support our efforts is incredibly helpful. Whether it's $3 or $3,000, every donation makes a _huge_ difference! Just $18 buys coffee and donuts for volunteers! **You can contribute to the campaign [HERE](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=8d07041605&e=fc26432468)**.

**2. Host a Meet-and-Greet for Drew**: Hosting a Meet-and-Greet in your home for Drew and inviting your friends, family, and neighbors is one of the best ways to spread our message. We're knocking on tens of thousands of doors, writing thousands of postcards, and making as many phone calls as possible to make this campaign a success. And we can't do it without you! Please visit** **[THIS](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=bfd27e569f&e=fc26432468) link to join #TeamDrew as a volunteer.

**4. Put up a Yard Sign:** One of the easiest and most effective ways to support our campaign is by putting a "Drew Johnson for Congress" sign in your yard. Almost every HOA in Southern Nevada allows at least one campaign yard sign. Email your name and address to [info@DrewforNevada.com](mailto:info@drewfornevada.com?subject=I'd%20like%20a%20yard%20sign%2C%20please!) and we'll ship one at **NO COST** to you!

LET'S SAVE AMERICA
This Isn’t About the Next Election—
It’s About the Soul of Our Nation
Dear Peter,
**We stand at a crossroads.** The threat of war looms large, and our freedoms are being systematically eroded by a government that is more concerned with silencing dissent than protecting democracy.
[We cannot afford to be passive. **And we need your support now more than ever.**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=save_america_9_26_24_all_1&n=5)
Here’s why:
According to a recent poll, **28% of Democrats wish that Donald Trump had been assassinated**.
Think about that for a moment. What does it say about the state of our country when a sizable portion of Americans openly wish for violence against a political opponent?
It’s a sign of deeper sickness in our society, a sickness that thrives on hatred, division, and censorship.
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=save_america_9_26_24_all_1&n=6)
Across Europe, censorship is becoming the norm. Free speech is dead in many parts of the world, and without it, democracy crumbles. Just this week, Brazil banned Twitter (X), and **yet we heard not a squeak of protest from the White House**.
Our movement to **protect our children’s health** and hold individuals accountable for prioritizing profits over people has become a groundswell.
Here at home, Vice President Harris and Hillary Clinton have publicly supported censorship, claiming that the First Amendment doesn't protect “misinformation.”
**But make no mistake—the First Amendment protects ALL speech** , including speech that the government calls misinformation.
[This is the terrifying reality we face: **_a government eager to control what we say, think, and believe_ , while pushing us into endless wars and silencing any opposition. **](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=save_america_9_26_24_all_1&n=7)
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=save_america_9_26_24_all_1&n=8)
**But there is hope.** Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and President Trump are united in their mission to end the forever wars and stop the destructive march toward global conflict. Both are committed to tearing down the machinery of surveillance and censorship that threatens to strangle our freedoms.
And President Trump has made a public, unwavering promise to end the chronic disease epidemic, to **Make America Healthy Again** , and to protect our children from the systemic corruption embedded in our government and healthcare institutions.
**RFK Jr. has been appointed to President Trump’s transition team, tasked with choosing the 14,000 people who will make up the next unity government** —a government that works for you, not for the corrupt bureaucrats profiting from sickness, war, and censorship.
[**Will you stand with RFK Jr.** as he helps to shape the future of this country and brings truth, peace, and freedom back to America?](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=save_america_9_26_24_all_1&n=9)
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=save_america_9_26_24_all_1&n=10)
**This is not just a fight for the next election—it’s a fight for the soul of our nation.**
If we don’t act now, the America we know and love will be lost. But with RFK Jr. by President Trump’s side, we have a real chance to restore our freedoms, protect our children, and bring peace to a divided world.
[Now is the time to act. Our freedom depends on it.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-em2?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=save_america_9_26_24_all_1&n=11)

body:
He covered up war crimes to keep the money flowing

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, This week, ProPublica published an investigative report confirming what many of us already suspected: U.S. Secretary of State Anthony Blinken deliberately ignored the explosive findings of both the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) and the State Department’s Bureau of Population, Refugees and Migration that Israel had been deliberately blocking humanitarian aid to Gaza, catapulting the population into what USAID called _“one of the worst humanitarian catastrophes in the world.”_ Shortly after receiving these damning reports in late April, Blinken asserted publicly on May 10th that _“(The State Department) does not currently assess that the Israeli government is prohibiting or otherwise restricting the transport or delivery of U.S. humanitarian assistance.”_
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=9_26_fundraising_pm&n=1)
---
Why would Secretary of State Blinken deliberately lie about Israeli war crimes that, as detailed by the USAID memo included “ _killing aid workers, razing agricultural structures, bombing ambulances and hospitals, sitting on supply depots and routinely turning away trucks full of food and medicine_ ”? Because a U.S. law, _The Foreign Assistance Act_ prohibits funding and supplying weapons to any nation that deliberately blocks U.S. humanitarian aid. For Blinken to have told the truth would have triggered that law and ended our government’s funding of this genocide. As Jill has stressed repeatedly, Israel can’t continue their genocidal campaign against the people of Gaza without the non-stop flow of U.S. weapons and billions upon billions of our taxpayer dollars. Blinken wasn’t going to allow any inconvenient truths about these crimes against humanity to get in the way of his role in aiding and abetting a genocide. [_**Peter, we have just over a month to reach millions of people with Jill and Butch’s anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate emergency campaign. Jill and Butch are the only candidates on the national stage who are committed to cutting off funding and aid to Israel on day one and ending the illegal occupation of Palestine. Can you dig deep today to make sure that we can get the word out to voters everywhere that they have the choice to vote Stein/Ware in November?**_](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=9_26_fundraising_pm&n=2)

**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Trump is attacking UOCAVA — the Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Voting Abroad Act. UOCAVA voters are Active Duty Military on deployment, and Trump wants their votes thrown out.
#
Peter -
Last week, we wrote to you about how Donald Trump is directing his lackeys in Congress to harass the VA because they are legally registering Veterans to vote.
It’s unconscionable that this traitor is trying to suppress the votes of the men and women who fought for this country. Full stop. But he hasn’t quit.
Now, Trump is attacking UOCAVA — _the Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Voting Abroad Act._ UOCAVA voters are Active Duty Military on deployment, and Trump wants their votes thrown out.
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-sep24.0zv8Fz&refcode=em240926-1-30&t=1&akid=30044%2E3013755%2EiZrftb)
Trump is already signaling that he will attack and seek to cancel many or all of their votes, in the name of "protecting them." This is what you do when you think uniformed members of the Armed Services are "suckers and losers," like Trump said.
The election is in less than 40 days. Trump’s gearing up to suppress the votes of Veterans and Active Duty, and that means we’ve got a lot of work to do.
A critical piece of infrastructure every year is VoteVets’ efforts to reach and turn out Veterans. Vet-to-Vet texting is a big part of that. Right now, we’re working on our targeting — the data we’ll use to cut lists and build out our network. Then we’ll mobilize our staff and volunteers. And then we’re going to let it rip, and text through hundreds of thousands of Veterans in critical swing seats and states to turn the tide.
Voter contact is the surest way to ensure the outcomes we need to see this November, and reaching the right voters with the right messengers is essential. We’re filling that role, and we could use your help to make it happen.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

A bombshell new report from ProPublica this week revealed that the Israeli
government has deliberately blocked food, medical supplies, and other aid
from reaching millions of suffering Palestinians for over a year.

What makes this even worse? U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken knew
this was happening, but lied about it to Congress and the American people.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240926_demand_blinken_resign/?source=em20240926-36024&akid=36024%2E1203867%2E3dYx93 ]Tweet from Brett Murphy: Leaked docs: While Gaza starved, USAID and
State’s refugees bureau came to a legally explosive conclusion — Israel
had deliberately prevented food & medicine from getting in. But Blinken
told Congress the exact opposite, so the arms could keep flowing.

Using starvation as a weapon is a war crime, and it goes against U.S. law.
But Sec. Blinken and the Biden Administration continued sending billions
of dollars worth of weapons and bombs to the Israeli military anyway.

Innocent Palestinians have died and millions more continue to suffer from
man-made famine while the U.S. ignores federal and international law to
enable Israel’s genocide and ethnic cleansing of Gaza.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240926_demand_blinken_resign/?source=em20240926-36024&akid=36024%2E1203867%2E3dYx93 ]Justice Democrats Rep. Rashida Tlaib has called on Sec. Blinken to

subject: Big news this morning
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BENNET FOR COLORADO
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-mucarsel-powell?refcode=X_092624_BennetMurcarsel-Powell_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-mucarsel-powell?refcode=X_092624_BennetMurcarsel-Powell_act]
Friend — I wanted to make sure you heard it from me first:
I've said for a while now that with our razor-thin blue majority at stake, all eyes will be on Florida's Senate race this November.
Well, as it turns out, national Democrats have kept tabs on our movement too, and they agree that the tide really is turning in our favor here in Florida.
Now, the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee (DSCC) — the campaign arm of Senate Democrats — has pledged a multi-million dollar investment to help me retire Rick Scott and flip Florida blue.
I can't overstate how massive this is for our chances of victory — especially so close to my final end-of-quarter deadline of the race next Monday. Truthfully, it's all thanks to the faithful and enthusiastic support of people like you.
However, while this puts a solid dent in the gap left in my $6 million end-of-quarter goal, there's still a hefty $3.01 million gap left to work through.

| **Road to Victory Roundup** _40 Days Until Election Day_
Thank you for your interest in Hogan For Maryland!
As we head to November, we are revamping our weekly newsletter to keep our grassroots team and voters informed.
**Mark Your Calendar: **We’d love for you to join Governor Hogan and the team at our **Baltimore County Bull Roast tomorrow Friday the 27th** with a special guest. Click [here](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=ab737ea83a&e=3ef74f1f93) for more information.
**Make a Plan to Vote:** Early in-person voting starts on Thursday, October 24th and runs through Thursday, October 31st. Mail in is also now underway. Request a mail-in ballot today [here](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=7434a94cd3&e=3ef74f1f93).
---
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=17fd76217e&e=3ef74f1f93)
| **Get the word out.** Follow and share our content on [Facebook](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=59df6755aa&e=3ef74f1f93), [X](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=7e44e954e0&e=3ef74f1f93), [YouTube](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=8eb8bf0ba8&e=3ef74f1f93), and [Instagram](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=80eaed0450&e=3ef74f1f93).
**Volunteer of the Week**
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | _Alexander Rauda, Prince George’s County_
Alexander is one of our most dedicated volunteers. He helps put up signs and shares Governor Hogan’s message in Prince George’s County. Alexander is also a valued member of our Hispanics for Hogan Coalition.
Volunteers who are doorknocking, putting up signs, writing postcards, and phone banking—just like Alexander—will be the key to our campaign’s success.
Find out more about how to join the frontlines [here](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=69dce2ba15&e=3ef74f1f93).
---
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=7308ee7cde&e=3ef74f1f93)
| Yesterday, Governor Hogan and the Hogan for Maryland team headed over to the Eastern Shore for the [**47th Annual J. Millard Tawes Crab and Clam Bake in Crisfield**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=df91b91eed&e=3ef74f1f93). Thank you to everyone who joined us!
---
| On Monday, Governor Hogan spoke to members of the **Maryland Fraternal Order of Police** in Ocean City at their annual convention.
---
| After last week, Hogan for Maryland has well **exceeded 100 stops** on our Strong Independent Leadership Tour, which started in May.
---
| We made multiple stops in**Montgomery County, Frederick County, Baltimore County, Howard County,** and the **Eastern Shore** in just the last week visiting fairs, festivals, parades and small businesses.
Governor Hogan also shared his campaign message with seniors at [Leisure World](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=62a8c1e703&e=3ef74f1f93), and [traveled to Mt. Airy](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=d8eae844ed&e=3ef74f1f93) to see firsthand the potential threat the Maryland Piedmont Reliability Project poses to local families, businesses and wildlife.
---
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=a0abf69ac6&e=3ef74f1f93)
| Last week, Governor Hogan released his [**Five Commitments to Maryland**](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=bec51988ad&e=3ef74f1f93) , which will guide his policy priorities and legislative agenda in the United States Senate.
---
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=f9f2344f12&e=3ef74f1f93)
| Governor Hogan also [sounded the alarm](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=ea94111879&e=3ef74f1f93) on the juvenile crime bill that is making Maryland communities less safe, and [urged Congress](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=42366937c4&e=3ef74f1f93) to codify access to IVF into law–something he has promised to do as U.S. Senator.
---
[](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=07520760e3&e=3ef74f1f93)
| Governor Hogan is continuing to make school safety a top issue in his campaign, and penned an [op-ed in the Baltimore Sun](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=c93f43001c&e=3ef74f1f93) about his policy plan to prevent school shootings. Read the full op-ed [here](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=7e99f7206c&e=3ef74f1f93).
---
| **Outside groups are spending millions of dollars to lie and mislead Maryland voters on Governor Hogan’s record.** We need your help to get the word out. Follow and share our content on [Facebook](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=cefb581a4c&e=3ef74f1f93), [X](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=cb574965dd&e=3ef74f1f93), and [Instagram](https://larryhogan.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=47050a5a8c0b2955735cf9828&id=6f2e7d3db1&e=3ef74f1f93).
---
| Talk to you soon!
Rob**Team Hogan**

If you’re like most conservatives, you get endless emails and text messages from candidates asking for money. _But how do you know if they are actually conservative and not just pretending?_ _How do you know if they even have a chance of winning?_ _How do you know if costly fundraising commissions and processing fees will consume most of your contribution?_ These are all important questions that everyone must ask if they want to be effective with their political contributions. **The Senate Conservatives Fund is one of the best ways to make your contributions count.** We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. Every SCF-endorsed candidate must undergo a vetting process to help us determine whether they share our principles and values and, more importantly, will actually fight for them after the election. Every candidate must also run a professional campaign capable of winning. But creating a list of conservative candidates is just the beginning; we also give you an _**[_**effective way to fund their campaigns!**_](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=fd2a3caddf774e368fb0c593bd7e4e6c&_e=YmuNY4EUrAdTfxS0XPk80-v8r00iIJKdUEfkvqcYzJzVSsZ_j5YuuV-Ndf6wxHyPHuDpnPgdsZohPHJp0FTlGgfsCr_VgIq0uLPjbHPTaMUKLPx5yVJJhkP-8MRpI-pR3D7An_fZ2-8gJiWRgD0CaXi0pZq1D_uKJXtwwyDT2nCNPxOPpM0u3KPdB0dQr3MyNxCg2FY1FG1XEAogzSc_oI0-k8-HQ5ycms-B7qI04JM%3D)**_ The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. Once you move away from the candidate’s campaign — whether it be a party committee, joint-fundraising committee, PAC, or other organization — your contribution's effectiveness declines. However, donating to multiple candidates can be complicated and time-consuming, and there could be hidden fees and expenses that make this less beneficial to the candidates. **That's why SCF allows you to donate to multiple candidates with one payment and why SCF pays all fundraising expenses related to those contributions.** _This saves candidates a ton of money._ As you know, processing fees are charged for all online transactions. What you probably don’t know is that candidates also often pay steep fundraising commissions to third-party vendors, which are at least 80% of the value of your contribution. Candidates have to pay outside vendors to help them find new donors across the country, and this service is quite expensive. **That means that when you get an email or text message from a candidate and click on the link to donate $100 to that candidate, the candidate will often get less than $20 after expenses.** This is why you should [**donate to candidates through SCF**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=fd2a3caddf774e368fb0c593bd7e4e6c&_e=YmuNY4EUrAdTfxS0XPk80-v8r00iIJKdUEfkvqcYzJzVSsZ_j5YuuV-Ndf6wxHyPHuDpnPgdsZohPHJp0FTlGkjVnvj2P886Ondmom7_yKP2mYhiWp5VXGNOkhQbdEiDkWDSOuL1Z7He_dESLGEyZWGPdABmwhdiWMzc3X_OZ5TciRDkzYavAIuYibFjGYTpj7HNkcgUTwemL4yDTeWjaPhMwzUQArL3nKrEkTpyCIM%3D) whenever possible. It’s one of the only ways to guarantee that the candidate will get 100% of your contribution with no hidden fees or expenses. And if you like our work and want to help us do more to promote good candidates, you can also contribute to SCF, which is our general fund. This will help us mobilize other patriots like you to help elect strong conservative leaders.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: President Biden’s new executive orders and actions will save lives
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
This afternoon I was proud to stand beside my friend President Joe Biden as he signed a series of executive actions that will make our country safer from gun violence.
#

Friends, this afternoon I was proud to stand beside my friend President Joe Biden as he signed a series of executive orders and actions that will make our country safer from gun violence.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240926-2-30&t=1&akid=9046%2E3935704%2E1B9LkD)
As I was at the White House today, I couldn’t help but think back to when I stood in the Rose Garden with then-Vice President Biden in April of 2013, when the United States Senate blocked a bipartisan bill to close the loopholes that let dangerous people buy guns without a background check. President Biden had called that day a “despicable day in the Senate.”
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240926-2-30&t=2&akid=9046%2E3935704%2E1B9LkD)
To be able to join him at the White House again today eleven years later, this time for celebratory reasons, was a surreal moment. It shows just how far we’ve come and how much progress we’ve made in our gun safety movement.
Today’s victories for our movement are the culmination of work since GIFFORDS’ founding eleven years ago—work that still isn’t over yet.
The Biden-Harris administration has put gun safety first over the past four years, and now we must elect Vice President Kamala Harris to carry on President Biden’s gun safety legacy as the next president of the United States.
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to fuel our work at GIFFORDS PAC to elect Vice President Harris this November and keep advocating for lifesaving gun safety legislation?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-sep24.n7q8o5&refcode=em240926-2-30&t=3&akid=9046%2E3935704%2E1B9LkD)

---
****
Thank you so much. I am in awe of all that we have accomplished together.
My very best,
Gabby Giffords

**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran. Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader. I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton. Like , Follow , and Subscribe! subject: Here's how Republicans like Josh Hawley failed veterans like me

body:
#
Peter — two years ago, Josh Hawley and 40 other Republicans blocked a bill to expand healthcare to millions of veterans like me who were exposed to toxic burn pits during their service.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/73767?refcode=em20240926-7821&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7821%2E614464%2Em_A4ht)
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[make your first donation of any amount toward my grassroots campaign to replace Hawley in the U.S. Senate.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/73767?refcode=em20240926-7821&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7821%2E614464%2Em_A4ht) But first, I want to tell you about the burn pit I lived next to in Iraq — and how politicians like him failed veterans like me.**
**[ADD DONATION NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/73767?refcode=em20240926-7821&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7821%2E614464%2Em_A4ht)**
It was 2009. I was stationed at the Al Taqaddum Airbase where I was a Marine Captain leading a police training team. Twelve Marines and a Navy Corpsman. Running missions through Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Ramadi.
It was my first of three tours of duty during the War on Terror. And from our camp, the base’s burn pit loomed over us.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/73767?refcode=em20240926-7821&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7821%2E614464%2Em_A4ht)
Smoke columns filled the sky and blew through our living space. We ran through it, joking about how we should be doing gas mask runs. For three months that pit bathed us in toxic fumes. We accepted it and focused on our duty.
For me, that was planning our routes and poring over intel to avoid the immediate danger: IEDs on all the convoys and missions we were running outside the wire. I was so proud to bring every member of that team home safely.
**Or so I thought — because, as it turns out, we couldn’t protect ourselves from our own country.**
When I got back from Iraq, I developed a persistent tickle in my throat. Constant irritation. I never had allergies before and annoyed myself with the constant throat clearing. Eventually, I was so embarrassed by it that I went to the base clinic. They said it was postnasal drip and that they could give me allergy medicine. There was no formal diagnosis. But over 10 years later, it’s still there.
Bothersome. Uncomfortable, but certainly manageable. And that’s about the best story you’ll hear about a vet who’s been exposed to burn pits. Many struggle with chronic respiratory issues. Migraines. Cancer.
So imagine how we all felt, watching all these Republicans like Josh Hawley, most of whom have never even worn the uniform, throw us a giant middle finger? I know that’s harsh language, but it has to be. Because what they did was about as anti-American as it gets. Patriots don’t attack veterans who suffered injuries or illness from being around those toxic pits.
Many of these same Republicans spent years voting to keep us in these forever wars, lying to the American people about what was really going on over there, and getting rich off their defense contractor stocks that skyrocket when we’re at war.
These people profited off of sending us over there only to screw us when we came back messed up. **It’s criminal — and I’m ready to do something about it.**
I served my country for 13 years in the United States Marine Corps. I’d give anything for this country — and that’s exactly why I’m running to replace Josh Hawley in the U.S. Senate.
**We deserve leaders who are willing to make even an ounce of the sacrifice our veterans have.[If you’re with me, please add a donation of $10 or anything at all to my grassroots campaign today so we can stay on track with our goals this month, get this message in front of Missouri voters, and defeat Josh Hawley this November.**](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/73767?refcode=em20240926-7821&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7821%2E614464%2Em_A4ht)
